jobs.title: Lead Principal Technical Program Manager
jobs.description:
Job Description

Partners with senior management and stakeholders to align priorities and goals using technical know-how in a fundamental engineering area or technical domain. Establishes scope and milestones for each aspect of a technical program, aligning to the broader program plan and company strategies and goals, managing efforts between cross-functional teams to deliver programs or services. Shapes and leads technical programs and highly complex, cross-organizational initiatives impacting products and business. Drives the management of and responses to issues, bottlenecks, and risks, serving as a point of escalation for all issues. Shapes program improvement strategies, leveraging best practices to drive transformational change and optimize processes across multiple teams. Shapes technical program improvement strategies, leveraging best practices to drive transformational change and optimize processes across multiple teams. Shapes technical collaboration across multiple teams, ensuring alignment of priorities and program goals. Provides expert technical guidance to shape and direct the automation of comprehensive reporting, leading collaboration with development teams to drive innovations in reports, dashboards, forecasts, and models for long-term technical program execution. Shapes the strategic direction of collaboration efforts as a technical liaison across stakeholder teams for high-impact technical programs.

Responsibilities

Key Responsibilities

Technical Management and Execution - Technical Management:

– Leverages technical knowledge to identify risks, manage scope, estimate program timelines, request feasibility, testing requirements, and determine appropriate resources.

– Designs and shapes the strategy for product or service delivery, ensuring alignment with the third party, security, export, and accessibility compliance requirements.

– Integrates program demands and resourcing.

– Leads rapid response to the most critical security escalations, coordinating across teams and departments and serving as the primary point of contact to executives to assess risk, determine comprehensive mitigation strategies, and ensure alignment and execution of the most effective path to resolution.

– Leads the transformation and optimization of processes to ensure the highest reliability and resilience of products or services.

Technical Management and Execution - Technical Strategy and Execution:

– Utilizes technical knowledge to identify and manage program dependencies and risks.

– Supports rapid response to escalations, coordinating within team and communicating to senior team members to assess risk, determine mitigation strategies, and execute the optimal proposed path to resolution.

– Shapes overall planning activities, ensuring alignment with enterprise architecture.

– Defines and enforces delivery standards and guidelines, ensuring security, scalability, and alignment with best practices.

– Develops Line of Business (LOB) strategies for change management and/or incident response to enhance operational efficiency.

Program Oversight - Strategy and Decision-Making:

– Leads the alignment of priorities with customers, service, and stakeholder teams through regular reporting to stakeholders and senior leadership.

– Establishes scope and milestones, aligning to the broader program plan and company strategies and goals, managing efforts between cross-functional teams to deliver programs or services.

– Leads efforts to define and monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) and measurement methods for LOB performance.

– Develops and communicates a comprehensive and strategic communication strategy of highly complex objectives to partners and customers.

Program Oversight - Program and Operations Management:

– Shapes and leads both technical and non-technical programs and highly complex, cross-organizational programs impacting products and business.

– Guides and mentors program staff (e.g., development, release management, customer success), providing expert technical support and strategic direction on removing barriers, including risks and issues in workflows.

– Provides guidance on developing and maintaining comprehensive program documentation (e.g., status reports, program plans) and develops risk mitigation strategies.

– Ensures attention to detail, including security and quality, in program management, from planning to execution and reporting.

– Chairs regular program status meetings, fostering collaboration and driving effective communication across teams and leaders.

– Partners with leadership to set service level agreements (SLAs) and productivity benchmarks aligned with long-term business goals.

– Shapes and leads forecasting program demands, funding, and resourcing.

– Leads the deployment of change management for programs, such as priority, scope, scheduling, development, requirement changes, and support.

Program Oversight - Risk Management:

– Drives the management of and responses to issues, bottlenecks, and risks, serving as a point of escalation for all issues.

– Develops plans based on the results of cost assessments, benefits analysis, and return on investment (ROI) to improve decision-making and risk mitigation strategies.

– Makes strategic decisions, balancing business needs, technical constraints, and long-term goals.

– Removes critical blockers for the program and determines optimal technical and resource options to drive the successful delivery and adoption of solutions.

Process Efficiency - Process Optimization:

– Shapes program improvement strategies, leveraging best practices to drive transformational change and optimize processes across the LOB.

– Leads the development and optimization of program objectives and workflows, while orchestrating the deployment of cross-functional solutions to address complex business problems.

– Collaborates with management to innovate and optimize processes and procedures to drive achievement of LOB goals.

Process Efficiency - Continuous Improvement:

– Champions LOB-wide integration of continuous improvement within programs, ensuring alignment of insights across many workstreams with business objectives and operational efficiency goals.

– Establishes and champions best practices for leveraging data insights at scale, influencing senior leadership decisions.

– Leads the development of innovative business-critical improvements to the solution's availability and reliability.

– Iterates processes based on feedback and KPIs, analyzing results through retrospectives.

– Defines requirements and configurations of existing and new development tools, where applicable.

Collaboration and Program Leadership - Cross Functional Collaboration:

– Shapes collaboration across multiple teams, ensuring alignment of priorities and program goals.

– Leads process improvements across the LOB, working with senior leaders to implement team-wide efficiency-driven solutions.

– Communicates strategic program updates and insights to leadership teams, shaping decisions at the LOB level.

– Develops and refines engagement approaches for key stakeholders, ensuring informed decision-making at scale to improve program planning and execution.

Collaboration and Program Leadership - Program Leadership:

– Shapes and leads programs to optimize organizational efficiency.

– Provides visionary technical direction and mentorship to cross-functional teams.

– Drives transformative change at all levels of the LOB, from initiation through delivery, while ensuring alignment with strategic goals.

– Ensures that the program team and other stakeholders are aligned with the program goals and motivated, identifying and addressing conflicts and issues.

Data and Analysis:

– Shapes and directs the automation of comprehensive reporting, collaborating with development teams to drive continuous improvement of reports, dashboards, forecasts, and models for program execution.

– Utilizes data insights to solve highly complex problems impacting the success of the program(s), including adherence to SLAs.

– Conducts analysis on a large number of data sources with high complexity, which may include competitive analysis, trend analysis, and KPI analysis, to drive data-informed decisions to support the program goals, presenting findings with immediate teams stakeholders.

Stakeholder Engagement:

– Shapes the strategic direction of collaboration efforts across stakeholder teams for high-impact programs.

– Serves as a trusted advisor to senior stakeholders, ensuring alignment between program priorities and business objectives.

– Defines strategies for enhancing customer engagement, aligning service offerings with evolving business needs.

– Drives large-scale product and process enhancements, influencing and guiding the LOB.

– Develops and presents advanced strategies to mitigate risks to customer satisfaction, assessing the impact of mitigation efforts on broader group objectives.

– Leads the alignment of varied priorities and Oracle commitments, ensuring optimal coverage and response to customer needs, minimizing organizational risk to programs.

Core Responsibilities

Planning & Execution:

– Manages and provides direction on timelines, deliverables, and budgets when applicable for critical high-impact projects or initiatives that impact the line of business, ensuring timely completion and adherence to requirements. Anticipates and plans for shifts in resources or timelines based on changing business priorities, ensuring optimal outcomes.

Collaboration & Partnership:

– Influences cross-functional leaders and external stakeholders to gain alignment on strategic objectives. Fosters partnerships with key business leaders, stakeholders, and/or customers, identifying opportunities for expanding partnerships and promoting long-term organizational success. Champions transparency and inclusivity by actively seeking, listening to, and incorporating diverse perspectives.

Problem Solving:

– Leads specialized, advanced problem-solving efforts, serving as an escalation point for complex issues. Guides others to leverage innovative data-driven techniques to address ambiguous or novel issues, identify root causes, and drives the implementation of solutions that prevent future issues.

Continuous Learning:

– Leverages deep industry knowledge and expertise to serve as a thought leader within the organization. Contributes to the advancement of the field or industry through thought leadership (e.g., conference presentations, white papers, research contributions). Maintains and evolves expertise in relevant areas by proactively monitoring emerging trends, technologies, and industry standards, ensuring the organization remains current with best practices. Champions continuous learning and knowledge sharing, promoting professional development across teams. Applies new knowledge to drive advancement and mentors others to do the same.

Continuous Improvement:

– Develops innovative solutions and drives the implementation of ideas that increase the efficiency and effectiveness of processes, protocols, and workflows across the organization. Evaluates effectiveness of updated approaches and methods for continued improvement to enhance efficiencies and ensure changes align with organizational goals. Designs and develops metrics to measure success of improvement initiatives.

Performance and Development:

– Serves as a subject matter expert regarding talent needs and organizational talent strategy. Imparts leadership and expert knowledge throughout the talent development pipeline including candidate interviews, candidate assessment, and hiring decisions, ensuring alignment with organizational talent strategy.

jobs.title: Technical Program Manager
jobs.description:
At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.

We are looking to hire an experienced Senior Technical Program Manager who can be part of a world-class team that builds Snowflake’s product and cloud platform. This role is a unique opportunity to make a significant impact by building a flexible, large scale, high-performance, and resilient platform for Snowlake features and services. Be part of the vision to create the best data cloud platform. Our ‘get it done’ culture allows everyone at Snowflake to have an equal opportunity to innovate on new ideas, create work with a lasting impact, and excel in a culture of collaboration.

AS A SENIOR TECHNICAL PROGRAM MANAGER, YOU WILL:

Be responsible for defining and delivering important programs with broad organizational, business and technical impact.
Provide cross-functional leadership with Engineering and Product Management, and inter/intra team communications to deliver outstanding program outcomes.
Bring strong, data-driven and strategic technical judgment to decisions.
Be hands-on, working closely with Software Engineers and Product Managers to design, build, and deliver the next generation of Snowflake services and apps.
Amplify your impact by educating and mentoring the TPM and Engineering communities on program management best practices.
Identify opportunities to improve execution of the organization as a whole, to increase engineering productivity through tools and light-weight processes. (Snowflake happens to have a nice data platform to use :-)

A SENIOR TECHNICAL PROGRAM MANAGER AT SNOWFLAKE IS EXPECTED TO HAVE:

5+ years of demonstrated industry experience and expertise leading medium to large complex engineering projects in current cloud technologies
Ability to thrive and succeed in a dynamic environment not slowed down by ambiguity or competing priorities
Experience working cross functionally with engineering, product management, and other functions involved in the product life cycle
Strong program management skills with technical and business acumen
Effective verbal and written communication and presentation skills, with the ability to interact with technical and non-technical groups
Excellent analytical, problem-solving, consultation and organizational skills
BS/MS/PhD degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related fields or equivalent practical experience (e.g. familiarity with SQL, Python, Data)

Snowflake is growing fast, and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Snowflake.

How do you want to make your impact?

Our programs require disciplined execution across engineering, operations, compliance, security, and customer-facing teams to deliver reliable, secure, and operationally ready cloud services.

Responsibilities

Strong understanding of IT systems, cloud technologies, cybersecurity and enterprise architecture.

jobs.description:
About The Company

Valon is the leading AI platform for mortgage servicing, building the AI-native operating system for regulated finance.

Before providing the system of record that powers the entire industry, we built and ran our own mortgage servicer on it. That gave us a real regulated environment to prove our technology could replace the mainframe systems servicers have used for decades. Carrington acquired that servicer and adopted ValonOS as its core platform, allowing us to focus entirely on scaling our SaaS platform.

ValonOS is now on track to power 1 in 6 U.S. mortgages across major mortgage servicers like Newrez, Carrington, and ServiceMac. Every process on the platform is structured and programmable, enabling our AI agents to perform core servicing work, like handling payments, escrow, and homeowner questions, directly within the system's controls.

We recently raised a $150 million Series D at a $2.3 billion valuation by new investor Ribbit Capital, with continued support from existing backer a16z, amongst others.

About The Role

Valon is rebuilding the mortgage servicing industry from the ground up . We're looking for a Technical Program Manager (TPM)
to join our team and help us launch complex products that will revolutionize how mortgage servicers operate. This is an exciting opportunity to shape the future of our TPM function and make a significant impact on our product development process.

In this role, you'll be instrumental in coordinating efforts across multiple engineering teams, ensuring seamless communication, and driving the successful delivery of our most critical initiatives. If you're a seasoned TPM with a passion for tackling challenging problems and a desire to build a function from the ground up, we encourage you to apply.

What You'll Do

Lead End-to-End Program Management: Own the planning, execution, and delivery of complex technical programs from conception through launch, including defining scope, setting timelines, and managing risks.
Drive Cross-Functional Coordination: Facilitate effective communication and collaboration between multiple engineering teams, product managers, design, operations, and other stakeholders to ensure alignment and shared understanding.
Optimize Development Processes: Identify and implement process improvements to enhance efficiency, predictability, and quality across the product development lifecycle.
Manage Stakeholder Expectations: Proactively communicate program status, risks, and dependencies to all relevant stakeholders, ensuring transparency and alignment.
Mitigate Risks and Resolve Issues: Identify potential roadblocks and actively work to resolve technical, operational, and organizational challenges that may impact program delivery.
Define and Track Metrics: Establish clear success metrics for programs and regularly track progress, providing data-driven insights to inform decision-making.
Contribute to Team Growth: As our second TPM, you'll have a unique opportunity to help define the vision, strategy, and best practices for the TPM function at Valon.

What You'll Bring

5+ years of experience as a Technical Program Manager in a fast-paced, complex software development environment.
Proven track record of successfully delivering large-scale, cross-functional technical programs.
Strong understanding of the software development lifecycle (SDLC) and various agile methodologies.
Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to influence and align diverse stakeholders.
Excellent problem-solving abilities and a proactive approach to identifying and mitigating risks.
Ability to thrive in a dynamic, rapidly evolving startup environment.
Prior experience in fintech team is a plus, but not required.

Benefits

Compensation: competitive salary with a meaningful stake in the company via equity, and 401k plan. Base salary will be dependent on leveling but can range between $185k-250k
Health & well-being: we’ll invest in your physical and mental well-being with comprehensive medical, dental, & vision benefits
Commuter benefits: We offer pre-tax deductions for public transportation, rideshare services, and parking expenses to make your commute more affordable and convenient.
Grow together: Company wide orientation for you to successfully onboard and other learning & development opportunities including regular review cycles that feature 360 degree feedback
Play together: quarterly budgets for team and company outings. Use it for team swag, cooking classes, or team dinners!
Generous time off: flexible paid time off, sick days, and 11 company holidays
Baby bonding time!: 12 weeks off for both birthing and non-birthing parents - fully paid so you can focus your energy on your newest addition

jobs.title: Senior Project Manager, Electricity Capital Project Delivery
jobs.description:
About Us

National Grid is hiring a Senior Project Manager for our Capital Project Delivery department in Syracuse NY or Northboro MA.

Every day we deliver safe and secure energy to homes, communities, and businesses. We are there when people need us the most. We connect people to the energy they need for the lives they live.

The pace of change in society and our industry is accelerating and our expertise and track record puts us in an unparalleled position to shape the sustainable future of our industry. To be successful we must anticipate the needs of our customers, reducing the cost of energy delivery today and pioneering the flexible energy systems of tomorrow. This requires us to deliver on our promises and always look for new opportunities to grow, both ourselves and our business

Job Purpose

The Reliability Compliance & Policy (RC&P) team helps protect the integrity of National Grid’s operations by providing leadership, governance, and oversight of the company’s NERC compliance framework. RC&P connects regulatory policy, standards development, compliance readiness, ongoing compliance, risk management, and regulatory assurance to help the business anticipate change, manage compliance risk, and maintain a strong and sustainable compliance posture.

The Senior Program Manager, NERC Standards Development & Compliance Readiness
owns the bridge between development of a reliability requirement and National Grid's ability to sustainably comply with that requirement. The value of the position is to influence the requirement early, understand its business impact, prepare the organization for it, and ensure a controlled transition into ongoing compliance.

The role is responsible for leading National Grid's engagement in the development, evaluation, interpretation, and implementation of new and revised North American Electric Reliability Corporation (NERC) Reliability Standards and applicable Northeast Power Coordinating Council (NPCC) requirements.

The role provides end-to-end leadership across the standards lifecycle, from emerging reliability and security issues and early standards development through formal commenting and balloting, applicability and gap assessment, compliance readiness, implementation, and transition to ongoing compliance.

Working with the affected functions across the organization, the Senior Program Manager translates evolving regulatory requirements into clear business impacts, coordinates subject matter expert engagement, identifies implementation risks, and drives the actions necessary to achieve timely and sustainable compliance.

The position also represents National Grid in industry forums and coordinates company positions on proposed standards, helping ensure National Grid has an effective voice in the development of reliability standards and requirements affecting the Bulk Electric System.

Key Accountabilities

Standards Development: Monitor and assess new and revised NERC Reliability Standards, NPCC requirements, reliability guidelines, and related initiatives. Coordinate National Grid SME review, comments, positions, and voting recommendations to help shape requirements before they are finalized.
Compliance Readiness & Implementation: Lead end-to-end readiness for new and revised Reliability Standards, including applicability and gap assessments, requirement interpretation, implementation planning, action tracking, development of procedures and controls, readiness sign-off, and transition to ongoing compliance.
Regulatory Interpretation & Risk: Evaluate requirements for applicability, implementation impacts, compliance risks, and potential business implications, documenting conclusions and escalating significant issues to appropriate stakeholders and leadership.
Stakeholder & SME Leadership: Lead cross-functional engagement with technical SMEs, compliance teams, and business leaders to ensure requirements are understood, responsibilities are clear, implementation challenges are resolved, and the organization is prepared to achieve sustainable compliance.
Industry Engagement: Represent and coordinate National Grid participation in NERC, NPCC, EEI, NATF, and other relevant industry forums to remain informed of emerging reliability issues, influence standards development, and bring industry perspectives and leading practices back to National Grid.
Governance & Program Management: Maintain oversight of the standards-development and compliance-readiness portfolio, including regulatory milestones, effective dates, implementation activities, risks, dependencies, and leadership reporting, while continually improving the governance framework, processes, tools, and controls supporting the program.
Compliance Assurance & Audit Support: Provide subject matter expertise for regulatory audits and reviews involving newly implemented standards, support regulatory inquiries and Requests for Information, and incorporate lessons learned from implementations and audits into future standards and readiness activities.

Qualifications

Required

Bachelor's degree in engineering, business, risk management, cybersecurity, legal, or a related discipline, or equivalent relevant experience.
Experience in the electric utility industry, regulatory compliance, reliability, risk management, operations, engineering, cybersecurity, or a related field.
Demonstrated ability to manage complex, cross-functional programs involving multiple organizations and competing priorities.
Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret complex technical and regulatory requirements and translate them into practical business actions.
Demonstrated experience facilitating discussions with technical SMEs and senior stakeholders.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to communicate complex regulatory issues to technical and executive audiences.
Strong organizational, project-management, facilitation, and stakeholder-management skills.
Occasional travel across the US and Canada is required (<5%); a US Passport is required.

Preferred

Experience with NERC Reliability Standards and Rules of Procedure, NPCC requirements, and/or the NERC Compliance Monitoring and Enforcement Program.
Experience with both Operations & Planning (O&P) and Critical Infrastructure Protection (CIP) Reliability Standards.
Experience with NERC or Regional Entity standards development, commenting, balloting, or industry committee processes.
Experience conducting compliance readiness, gap assessments, applicability evaluations, internal control assessments, or regulatory implementation programs.
Experience developing or reviewing RSAWs, compliance evidence, procedures, controls, or audit documentation.
Familiarity with Governance, Risk & Compliance platforms such as Archer.

More Information

Salary

Northboro, MA: $123,000 - $144,000 a year

Syracuse, NY: $109,000 - $128,000 a year

Salary is commensurate with experience and location.

National Grid will not be providing visa sponsorship for this position now or in the future. You must have the ability to work without a need for current or future visa sponsorship.

This position has a career path which provides for advancement opportunities within and across bands as you develop and evolve in the position; gaining experience, expertise and acquiring and applying technical skills. Candidates will be assessed and provided offers against the minimum qualifications of this role and their individual experience.

National Grid maintains affirmative action programs for individuals with disabilities and protected veterans.

jobs.title: Senior Project Manager, ERP Modernization
jobs.description:
Hybrid, Downtown Chicago, Illinois

We’re looking for a Senior Project Manager to join Amer Sports’ PMO team out of our Chicago office.

Amer Sports is a global collective of iconic sports and outdoor brands, powered by a community of people who share a passion for authenticity, impact, and excellence. We bring together leading brands, talented teams, and a culture built on collaboration. If you’re looking for an environment where you can make an impact and grow your career, we invite you to explore the opportunity below.

What You Will Be Doing

The Senior Project Manager, ERP Modernization is a hands-on role within the PMO team, supporting large-scale ERP modernization and transformation programs in an international environment. This role owns and coordinates professional program reporting for senior management, actively manages dependencies between Amer Sports programs and initiatives, and works closely with internal and external Senior Program Leadership to define the right focus and messaging for executive reporting.

The role takes hands-on ownership of project delivery, reporting, and quality assurance within the PMO team and contributes to the continuous improvement of PMO processes and ways of working. The scope of ownership is matched to the experience of the selected candidate.

Project Delivery & PM Ownership

Take hands-on ownership of full lifecycle SAP project delivery across all phases (planning, design, build, testing, deployment, stabilization).
Drive complex project execution, ensuring alignment with strategic business objectives.
Manage commercial and contractual aspects, including financial oversight and compliance.
Oversee the implementation of SAP modules, ensuring seamless integration with existing systems.
Coordinate work with other project managers and workstream leads as required.

Scope, Budget & Resource Management

Define, plan, and control project scope in accordance with business goals.
Manage budgets and ensure cost effectiveness across complex project landscapes.
Allocate and optimize resources across multiple SAP workstreams.
Actively manage dependencies between Amer Sports programs and initiatives, and support alignment of project scope at the portfolio level.

Risk, Quality & Governance

Identify, assess, and mitigate risks and issues on both tactical and strategic levels.
Provide advanced risk management for large-scale and multi-layered project environments.
Ensure delivery meets quality standards and adheres to governance frameworks.
Conduct ongoing project reviews and own and coordinate professional program reporting for senior management.

Stakeholder & Communication Management

Maintain effective communication with cross-functional teams, senior stakeholders, and executives, and work closely with internal and external Senior Program Leadership to define the right focus and messaging for executive reporting.
Clearly present complex information, KPIs, and data insights to both technical and non-technical audiences, using excellent PowerPoint skills and AI-supported tools for information aggregation and presentation.
Moderate project meetings, workshops, and steering committees with a strong focus on outcomes.
Navigate different cultural communication and leadership styles for effective international collaboration.

Collaboration & Continuous Improvement

Collaborate with and motivate cross-functional teams, including consultants and business stakeholders.
Contribute to the continuous improvement of PMO team processes and ways of working.
Foster a collaborative environment and promote knowledge sharing.
Support change management and stakeholder alignment across diverse cultures.

What You Need To Succeed

7–10 years of project management experience with meaningful hands-on experience on at least one large-scale, global ERP (SAP strongly preferred) or a digital transformation program end-to-end (design, build, test, cutover, hypercare)
Experience managing large and complex international ERP projects and change initiatives with business-process integration across finance, order management, supply chain / warehouse, data, and interfaces.
Experience owning program governance artifacts and reporting for senior stakeholders, including Steering Committee-level reporting
Proven experience indirectly supervising teams and/or other project managers. Successful track record with multiple full lifecycle ERP implementations
Strong program governance and PM capability: integrated planning, governance, RAID / change control, stakeholder management, and delivery assurance
PMP, PRINCE2, or equivalent project management certification
Experience with complex, multi-module ERP implementations and industry best practices
Able to operate effectively in a matrixed, multi-partner environment (SAP Project teams, system integrators, Group IT, brand teams) with competing priorities and tight timelines
Proficiency in project management methodologies (Agile, Waterfall, hybrid)
Advanced use of project management tools for managing complex and parallel projects
Ability to drive initiatives hands-on and collaborate with other project managers
Excellent communication and influencing skills across all levels, including C-level
Strong strategic decision-making and risk management capabilities
Holistic understanding of enterprise processes and ERP system’s role in business transformation

What We Consider a Plus

Prior consulting experience
SAP Project Manager certification
SAP ECC to S/4 HANA Project Management experience

What’s In It For You

At Amer Sports, you’ll be part of a global community of people who care about what they do and how they do it. Across our teams and brands, we are driven by ambition, collaboration, and a shared purpose of elevating the world through sport.

Benefits & Compensation

Medical, dental and vision
401k with company match
Life insurance
Pre-tax transit discounts
Paid maternity/paternity leave
Smart casual dress
Employee product benefits: Enjoy access to employee discounts on quality products from our iconic brands.
Global collaboration: Work with diverse, international teams and collaborate across brands, functions, and markets, learning from different perspectives along the way.

What to expect from the recruitment process

CV screening: Every CV is reviewed by a human.
Phone screening: A conversation with Amer Sports’ HR manager to discuss the role, our organization, and your expectations.
Interviews: Usually 2–4 rounds, including interviews with the hiring manager and prospective team.
Case studies or assessments: Your role may require practical tests, such as presentations or case studies.
Feedback and decision: We aim to provide feedback throughout the process.

Interested?

Please submit your application via the application form. CVs sent by email will not be considered or processed.

If you have any questions or need clarification at any stage of the application process or during your journey with us, please don't hesitate to reach out to talentacquisition@amersports.com (HR).
Apply and join us in striving for excellence at each step!

jobs.description:
Application Close Date

Applications will be accepted on an ongoing basis until the requisition is closed.

At Blue Origin, we envision millions of people living and working in space for the benefit of Earth. We’re working to develop reusable, safe, and low-cost space vehicles and systems within a culture of safety, collaboration, and inclusion. Join our team of problem solvers as we add new chapters to the history of spaceflight! 

This role is part of Blue Origin corporate functions, providing centralized support across Blue Origin business unit teams, functions, and locations.

This role is part of Facilities, Maintenance, Security & Operations (FMSO), the organization responsible for the design, construction, operation, and maintenance of the facilities and infrastructure that enable Blue Origin's mission across all sites. This includes new facility construction, capital renovations, and infrastructure build-outs supporting production ramp, test operations, and launch vehicle programs including specialized infrastructure.

This role supports the FMSO Construction vertical, which is responsible for delivering capital construction projects safely, on schedule, and on budget across all Blue Origin locations. This position reports directly to the Sr. Director of Construction and support FMSO’s goals and strategic objectives. This role also maintains a close key partnership with FMSO leadership, ensuring construction program status, risks, and priorities stay tightly aligned with the FMSO-wide program management rhythm, portfolio reporting, and leadership communications while providing field-level execution status, progress, and issues that this role rolls up into program-level schedule, budget, and risk reporting for leadership.

Responsibilities

Apply advanced professional expertise in the practical application of project management discipline across the full construction development cycle
Develop and implement advanced process improvement techniques for construction program delivery
Ensure all project control systems within the scope of assigned projects are in place and integrate project data for decision-makers
Lead others and direct all phases of assigned cross-organizational construction projects, including coordination across Construction Managers
Identify key stakeholder project-specific objectives and requirements; ensure assigned individuals are executing identified and assigned complex tasks with appropriate tracking and reporting per plan
Develop and manage relationships within and outside the immediate team, representing FMSO as the prime point of contact on construction projects requiring coordination between organizations (engineering, procurement, EH&S, general contractors, subcontractors)
Regularly collaborate with key contacts outside own area of expertise (engineering, EH&S, procurement) to develop solutions reviewed by senior program and technical leaders
Support peer and project reviews throughout FMSO and provide performance assessment to appropriate leadership
Mentor Project and People Managers and other project personnel; responsible for reviewing and validating the accuracy of field-level reporting rolled into program status
Develop advanced solutions to complex construction problems requiring ingenuity, creativity, and innovation, where analysis of schedule, cost, or field-condition data requires in-depth evaluation of variable factors
Use advanced judgment in selecting methods and techniques for resolving construction issues, weighing trade-offs between low, medium, and high-performance measures
Lead anomaly investigations, root cause analyses, and development of recovery plans for schedule or cost deviations
Identify lessons learned and historical reporting to incorporate into future construction project plans

Minimum Qualifications

B.S. degree or equivalent experience in Construction Management, Engineering, Architecture, Business, or related disciplines
8+ years of experience planning and managing construction projects/programs, including managing requirements, priorities, scope, schedule, integration, and cost in a capital delivery environment
Demonstrated experience tracking and improving construction schedule performance and cost/rate management
Demonstrated ability to develop and execute project plans across all phases (Initiating, Planning, Execute & Complete, Close-out) in accordance with accepted project management industry standards
Able to quickly build and navigate a professional network within the organization, including interfacing with Construction Managers, architects, engineers, general contractors, subcontractors, procurement/buyers, other TPMs, and support personnel
Experience with P6 Primavera, MS Project, or similar scheduling software packages
Excellent written, communication, and presentation skills
Comfortable in a fast-paced, dynamic environment
Self-starter, strong bias for action and sense of ownership
Attention to detail and high level of accuracy
Ability to balance technical, business, and organizational influences
Demonstrated history of independent work, foreseeing problems, delivering on commitments, and accountability
Ability to coordinate across multiple field construction leads and synthesize field-level input into program-level status

Desired Qualifications

Master's degree in construction management, engineering, business, or project management
Experience with facility construction or infrastructure delivery supporting manufacturing, test, or launch operations environments, including specialized infrastructure such as launch pads, test stands, or similar
Experience coordinating design, permitting, and construction phases for industrial or high-bay facilities
Demonstrated success working with general contractors, subcontractors, and field construction leadership to ensure on-time, on-budget delivery of high-quality construction
Knowledge of building systems and infrastructure, such as MEP, structural, and site utilities, including construction-specific scheduling and cost tracking tools
Program Management Professional (PMP) certification and Earned Value Management System (EVMS) experience; experience with critical path scheduling, risk management, and cost account management such as EVM
Experience overseeing or coordinating the work of field construction superintendents/managers across multiple concurrent projects

Base Pay Range For

WA applicants is $145,188.00 - $203,263.20

Other Site Ranges May Differ

Culture Statement

Don’t meet all desired requirements? Studies have shown that some people are less likely to apply to jobs unless they meet every single desired qualification. At Blue Origin, we are dedicated to building an authentic workplace, so if you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every desired qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.

Export Control Regulations

Applicants for employment at Blue Origin must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e. current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum.

Background Check

Required for all positions: Blue’s Standard Background Check
Required for Certain Job Profiles: Defense Biometric Identification System (DBIDS) background check if at any time the role requires one to be on a military installation
Required for Certain Job Profiles: Drivers who operate Commercial Motor Vehicles with a Gross Vehicle Weight (GVW), Gross Vehicle Weight Rating (GVWR) or combination of power unit and trailer that meets or exceeds 10,001 lbs. and/or transports placardable amounts of hazardous materials by ground in any vehicle on a public road while in commerce, may be subject to additional Federal Motor Carrier Safety Regulations including: Driver Qualification Files, Medical Certification (obtained before onboarding), Road Test, Hours of Service, Drug and Alcohol Testing, vehicle inspection requirements, CDL requirements (if applicable) and hazardous materials transportation/shipping training.
Required for certain Job Profiles: Ability to obtain and maintain Merchant Mariner Credential, which includes pre-employment and random drug testing as well as DOT physical

Benefits

Benefits include: Medical, dental, vision, basic and supplemental life insurance, paid parental leave, short and long-term disability, 401(k) with a company match of up to 5%, and an Education Support Program.
Stock Options for all regular employees (working at least 20 hours/week)
Paid Time Off: Up to four (4) weeks per year based on weekly scheduled hours, and up to 14 company-paid holidays.
Dependent on role type and job level, employees may be eligible for benefits and bonuses based on the company's intent to reward individual contributions and enable them to share in the company's results, or other factors at the company's sole discretion. Bonus amounts and eligibility are not guaranteed and subject to change and cancellation. Please check with your recruiter for more details.

jobs.title: Information Systems Security Manager (ISSM)
jobs.description:
Riverside Research is an independent National Security Nonprofit dedicated to research and development in the national interest. We provide high-end technical services, research and development, and prototype solutions to some of the country’s most challenging technical problems.

All Riverside Research opportunities require U.S. Citizenship.

Position Overview

Riverside Research is seeking an Information System Security Manager to administer several classified programs, to include Assessment & Authorization (A&A) requirements. This position functions as an ISSM, responsible for the development and oversight of a comprehensive information security program as identified in applicable customer requirements to include NISPOM, ICD 503/CNSSI 1253, DFARS, NIST 800-53, NIST 800-171, JSIG, etc.

Responsibilities

Create and maintain A&A packages, System Security Plans (SSPs), Risk Assessment Reports (RARs), Security Controls Traceability Matrices (SCTMs) and Plans of Action & Milestones (POA&Ms) for assigned classified systems
Establish and administer appropriate security systems, policies, standards, and procedures in compliance with applicable government and corporate directives, guidelines, and contractual obligations
Conduct analysis and assessment of the security control assessment guidance, procedures, and templates, ensuring correct and uniform implementation of the new RMF based assessment processes
Configure and validate information system compliance using DISA STIGs, SCAP Compliance Checker (SCC) and STIG Viewer
Conduct regular audits/CM in accordance with government customer requirements
Provide technical and professional leadership to support personnel, provide oversight for assigned classified system compliance and conduct self-assessments at multiple Riverside Research offices
Provide CM for security-relevant information system software, hardware and firmware
Investigate information system security violations and prepare reports with corrective actions and preventative measures.
Make recommendations regarding tools, trend analysis and applicable network countermeasures
Interfaces directly with DCSA or other DoD entities to conduct Information System security inspections, tests, and reviews
Guarantee system security requirements are addressed during all phases of system life cycle
Ensures system security assessments and audits are completed and documented
Certify that all Information System authorization documentation is current and accessible to authorized individuals
Supervisor assigned ISSO's

Qualifications

Required Qualifications:

Active Top Secret/SCI Security Clearance and the ability to obtain and maintain a CI Poly
Bachelor's degree in Cybersecurity, Information Systems, Computer Science, Information Assurance, Business, or a related discipline.
Twelve (12) years of progressively responsible experience in cybersecurity, information assurance, governance, risk, compliance, or related disciplines, including at least three (3) years of leadership experience managing technical teams or enterprise cybersecurity programs.
Above Experience to consist of:
NIST 800-53 and Risk Management Framework (RMF) based accreditations
Working in a classified environment consisting of multiple Collateral, SCI and/or SAP systems
Managing multiple projects at one time that could have many tasks within each.
Working with Windows operating systems
Developing standard operating procedures and system security plans
Supervising and mentoring ISSO level team

Certification Requirements: Current DoD 8570.1-M IAM Level 1
Self-motivated and possess good written, verbal, listening and presentation skills
Strong customer service, leadership and team building skills
Organizational skills to include attention to detail, time management, ability to multitask and prioritize.
Must live or relocate to a commutable distance of Beavercreek, Ohio

Global Comp

$130,000 - $180,000 This represents the typical compensation range for this position based on experience, location and other factors.

Closing Statement

Riverside Research Institute is a not-for-profit, technology-oriented defense company, where service to our customers and support of our staff is our overall mission. Riverside is an affirmative action-equal opportunity employer and complies with all applicable federal, state, and local laws regarding recruitment and hiring. jobs.title: Staff Technical Program Manager, IT Audit & Governance
jobs.description:
We're looking for a senior, hands-on leader to own IT audit and governance across all of our applications, infrastructure, and systems. You'll be accountable for keeping IT audit-ready every day: SOX ITGCs and ITACs, plus the broader audit and governance obligations that touch the technology stack (SOC reports, ISO, security and regulatory audits).

This role is about accountability and execution. You'll work with cross-functional IT leaders across Infrastructure, Engineering, Security, Cloud, Enterprise Applications, and Business Systems to make sure controls are owned, operated, evidenced, and remediated on time. You'll also be the primary IT liaison to Internal Audit, Finance/SOX PMO, and external auditors. You operate independently, influence without authority, and can speak credibly with an engineer about a CI/CD pipeline and with the CAO about a deficiency.

We're looking to speak with candidates based in Palo Alto or New York City for our hybrid working model.

What You'll Do

Own audit and governance across all IT

Own the audit and governance program across all IT applications, infrastructure, cloud platforms, and supporting systems
Maintain a complete inventory of systems, owners, and applicable audit and compliance obligations (SOX, SOC 1/SOC 2, ISO 27001, and other regulatory or customer requirements)
Build and run an IT audit calendar that coordinates SOX, internal audit, external audit, and compliance activities to reduce duplicate asks and audit fatigue
Establish governance standards, policies, and control frameworks that apply consistently across IT

Drive accountability and execution with IT leaders

Partner with cross-functional IT leaders to assign clear control and remediation ownership, with defined deadlines and escalation paths
Run regular governance forums and control health reviews with IT leadership, reporting status, risks, and overdue items
Hold teams accountable for timely control execution, evidence quality, and issue closure, escalating early when commitments slip
Translate audit and compliance requirements into practical work that engineering and infrastructure teams can adopt without slowing delivery

Own ITGC and ITAC compliance

Own the end-to-end SOX IT program: scoping inputs, control design, ownership, evidence, readiness testing, and issue management
Maintain the ITGC framework (access management, change management, IT operations, SDLC) across all in-scope applications, databases, operating systems, and cloud infrastructure
Own ITAC strategy and coverage with Finance and business-system owners: automated controls, configurations, interfaces, calculations, and approval workflows
Own IPE/report validation, ITAC baselines, and segregation of duties (SoD) across ERP and key financial applications

Design, operate, and strengthen controls

Design controls that are engineered into IT workflows (ticketing, CI/CD, IAM, CMDB) rather than layered on manually
Run readiness and self-assessment testing ahead of Internal Audit and external auditor testing
Rationalize overlapping controls across frameworks so one control and one piece of evidence can satisfy multiple requirements
Drive automation and continuous control monitoring to reduce manual effort and audit burden
Manage SOC 1/SOC 2 report reviews, CUECs, and third-party/vendor control dependencies

Drive remediation and issue management

Own the issue lifecycle across IT, from identification and root cause through remediation plan, validation, and closure
Prepare management's response to audit findings and provide the IT perspective on deficiency severity with Finance, Legal, and Internal Audit
Report control health and remediation status to IT leadership, the CAO, and the Audit Committee as needed

Be the IT face to auditors and the business

Serve as primary IT contact for Internal Audit and external auditors on scope, walkthroughs, evidence requests, and reliance strategy
Coordinate PBC requests, evidence standards, and timelines across IT teams
Train and enable control owners and IT leaders on audit requirements, evidence quality, and their responsibilities

Lead and elevate the program

Set standards for control documentation, evidence, and issue management across IT
Mentor analysts and guide co-source or outsourced resources
Contribute to emerging governance areas such as AI/emerging technology

What You'll Bring

Required

8-12+ years of experience in IT audit, SOX compliance, IT governance, or technology risk (Big 4, internal audit, or in-house IT GRC)
Deep, hands-on experience with SOX 404 ITGCs and ITACs in a public company
Working knowledge of COSO, COBIT, and PCAOB AS 2201, and how external auditors approach IT reliance and ITAC testing
Experience across modern technology environments: cloud (AWS/Azure/GCP), SaaS, ERP (e.g., Oracle, NetSuite, SAP), infrastructure, and identity/access platforms
Familiarity with other frameworks and audits (SOC 1/SOC 2, ISO 27001, NIST) and how to harmonize them
Proven track record of owning programs end-to-end and driving accountability and execution across multiple teams and senior leaders without direct authority
Excellent communication and executive presence, including negotiating with auditors and briefing senior leadership
Bachelor's degree in Information Systems, Accounting, Computer Science, or a related field

Preferred

CISA, CISSP, CIA, CPA, or equivalent certification
Experience with GRC and audit tools (e.g., AuditBoard, ServiceNow GRC, Workiva, Archer)

jobs.description:
About MIB

At MIB our people are passionate about making roads safer by getting uninsured and hit-and-run drivers off our roads. Working in partnership with the Police, Insurers and Government our collective aim is to make it a thing of the past but, until that’s accomplished, we’re here to compensate victims quickly, fairly and compassionately.

Last year we helped more than 34,000 people struck by uninsured and hit-and-run drivers and paid over £400 million in compensation to support victims rebuild their lives.

About The Role

Are you passionate about information security and helping organisations build secure, resilient ways of working?

As Information Security Manager
, you'll play a pivotal role in supporting MIB's client companies to strengthen their security posture, manage risk with confidence and embed effective security practices across their organisations.

Acting as a trusted advisor and subject matter expert, you'll provide specialist guidance, assurance and project support, helping client companies develop and maintain proportionate security policies, standards, controls and frameworks that align with their business objectives and contractual obligations.

This is an influential role where you'll work closely with stakeholders to ensure information security risks are understood, managed effectively and integrated into everyday operations. You'll help organisations protect the confidentiality, integrity and availability of their information and systems, enabling them to operate securely in an increasingly complex threat landscape.

If you enjoy building trusted relationships, translating security requirements into practical business solutions and making a tangible impact across multiple organisations, this is an exciting opportunity to shape and strengthen information security at a strategic level.

This Will Be Achieved By

Providing a focal point within MIB for client company information security guidance, assurance and subject matter expertise.
Supporting the alignment of client company information security activity to agreed client company objectives and obligations.
Supporting an effective information security risk management approach for client companies, helping assess information security risks, agree proportionate treatment plans and track progress to closure.

Key Responsibilities

General

Support the Head of Information Security and the Information Security GRC Manager by providing client company insight to inform the wider security strategy where relevant.
Share knowledge, guidance and good practice with colleagues supporting client company information security activity.
Work with Security Operations, Engineering and Architecture functions to ensure client company requirements are understood and appropriately reflected in advice, assurance and control recommendations.
Provide client company teams with security-focused support, training and consultancy to help them understand and meet applicable security standards, policies and legislation.
Engage with ODT leadership, supporting functions and business stakeholders to support the delivery of effective information security practices within client companies.
Produce and share management information on the performance of client company information security controls, providing assurance on maturity, risk exposure and control effectiveness.
Recommend improvements to client company information security standards, guidance and control expectations through continuous improvement activity.
Develop and maintain procedures and guidance that help client companies understand and respond to relevant threats and vulnerabilities.
Support client companies to embed appropriate information security behaviours and practices that help protect their information and information systems.
Review and advise on information security clauses, obligations and controls within client company contracts.
Keep up to date with emerging trends, technologies and legislation relevant to client company information security and assurance.
Act as the client company point of contact for information security governance, risk, assurance and compliance matters.
Support client company governance forums by providing clear reporting, insight and challenge on key information security risks, audit outcomes, control maturity and remediation progress.
Support the development, review and alignment of client company information security policies, standards, procedures and guidance.
Maintain a proportionate client company information security risk and compliance approach, including information security risk assessments, treatment plans, escalation, tracking and a rolling compliance schedule.
Review, challenge and track client company control actions, vulnerabilities and information security incidents to ensure appropriate mitigation and management focus.
Coordinate client company audit and assurance activity, including audit readiness, evidence quality, audit findings, remediation plans and action closure.
Measure and report on the performance and compliance of key client company information security controls, including policy, process and relevant technical control expectations.
Support client company initiatives, solutions and services where information security advice, assurance or oversight is required.

Skills And Experience

A thorough understanding of the information security threat landscape, significant risks, technical developments and regulatory expectations as they apply to client company environments.
Strong interpersonal and stakeholder management skills are essential, as the role must influence and support client company teams and stakeholders without direct ownership of their operational delivery.
Extensive experience as an information security practitioner, ideally within a complex supplier, client or multi-stakeholder environment.
Direct experience of supporting information security governance, risk and compliance activity in a stakeholder-facing or advisory capacity.
Experience and knowledge of supporting information security risk assessments, including review, challenge and assurance of risk treatment plans.
Proven experience of developing or supporting information security policies, procedures, standards and guidance.
Experience supporting ISO27001-aligned controls, assurance activity or equivalent information security frameworks.
Ability to harness the commitment and contribution of colleagues outside the direct span of control.
Excellent written and oral communication skills.
Ability to research, assess and recommend improvements to governance, risk and compliance capabilities and maturity.
Ability to present ideas in non-technical, business-friendly and accessible language.
Ability to effectively prioritise and execute tasks in a high-pressure environment.

One Or More Of The Following Qualifications Are Desirable

Certified Information Security Manager (CISM)
Certified Information Systems Auditor (CISA)
Certified in the Governance of Enterprise IT (CGEIT)

jobs.title: Sr Program Manager, MX Holiday & Contingency
jobs.description:
Description

Want to work at a company that aims to be Earth's most customer-centric? Then meet Amazon. Amazon has spent more than 25 years inventing on behalf of customers and is now one of the world's largest online retailers and marketplaces. Our entrepreneurial culture has produced new products and services such as Echo and Amazon Web Services.

The Holiday and Contingency Planning (HCP) team coordinates Amazon's operational response to holidays, planned events and unplanned contingencies. The goal is to protect the customer experience and limit operational impact, balancing reliability against speed. As a central coordination team, HCP plans and executes network configuration changes that adjust customer promises and package flow, so the network keeps performing and recovers quickly from disruption.

We are hiring an HCP Program Manager in Mexico to own contingency management for the Mexico network and support HCP programs across LATAM. Mexico's network faces many kinds of disruption: national and state holidays, peak events such as Hot Sale and El Buen Fin, Semana Santa and Día de Muertos, hurricanes and floods, road blockades and civil demonstrations, and cross-border (US–MX) flow disruptions. You will work with stakeholders across all miles and lines of business, including Middle Mile/ATS and Relay Operations, Last Mile (AMZL and DSP network), Fulfillment and Sort Centers, First Mile/3P, Regional Planning and Business Continuity teams. You will also partner with Legal, Public Policy, PXT and Tech teams, and with the global HCP team in India and other regions.

We're looking for a hands-on, motivated self-starter who is passionate about using data to make quick decisions and who exemplifies "Bias for Action" and "Are Right, A Lot." The successful candidate has strong analytical and problem-solving skills, is detail-oriented, and is comfortable working with large data sets. They communicate complex analysis clearly, build strong relationships with stakeholders, and drive toward simple, scalable solutions to difficult problems.

Key job responsibilities

Based in Mexico, or open to relocation
Own the end-to-end holiday planning & contingency management for Mexico: plan the holiday and event calendar, assess risk, define the network response (promise, capacity and flow changes), execute it, and run post-event reviews.
Lead real-time response to unplanned disruptions such as weather, blockades and carrier or site outages. Coordinate decisions across miles and drive fast recovery.
Analyze historical event performance, including delivery experience, promise accuracy, backlog and recovery time. Turn the analysis into recommendations for senior leadership.
Build and improve the team's reporting tools, mechanisms and processes so internal and external partners get more actionable, granular data.
Drive the operating cadence: WBR/MBR inputs, goal setting, goal tracking and process improvement for HCP Mexico.
Standardize and scale HCP mechanisms across LATAM. Bring best practices from other regions and share Mexico learnings with the global team.
Communicate complex analyses and decisions clearly, in writing and verbally, in Spanish and English, to audiences from operations teams to senior leaders.

A day in the life

You start by checking the risk outlook for the coming days: upcoming holidays, weather alerts and planned demonstrations. You align with Middle Mile, Last Mile and site operations on any network changes needed, then go deeper on data to size a promise adjustment for an upcoming peak or holiday. You might lead a cross-functional event review, write the narrative for leadership, or work with tech partners to automate a manual step in the contingency process. When something unexpected happens, you coordinate the response and keep stakeholders informed until the network recovers.

About The Team

HCP is a ROW team spanning operations, program management and tech, with members in India and LATAM. We value bias for action, being right a lot, and simple, scalable solutions to complex problems.

**Inclusive team culture**

At Amazon we embrace our differences and are committed to furthering our culture of inclusion, reinforced by our Leadership Principles, which remind team members to seek diverse perspectives, learn and be curious, and earn trust.

**Mentorship & career growth**

The team has a broad mix of experience levels and tenures. We celebrate knowledge sharing and mentorship, and assign projects with each team member's growth in mind.

Basic Qualifications

5+ years of program or project management experience
Experience using data and metrics to determine and drive improvements
Experience owning program strategy, end to end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership
Experience owning program strategy, end-to-end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership
Bachelor's degree or equivalent
Speak, write, and read fluently in English, and have the ability to take direction in English

Preferred Qualifications

3+ years of driving process improvements experience
Master's degree, or MBA in business, operations, human resources, adult education, organizational development, instructional design or related field
3+ years of stakeholder management experience

ValonOS is now on track to power 1 in 6 U.S. mortgages across major mortgage servicers like Newrez, Carrington, and ServiceMac. Every process on the platform is structured and programmable, enabling our AI agents to perform core servicing work, like handling payments, escrow, and homeowner questions, directly within the system's controls.

We recently raised a $150 million Series D at a $2.3 billion valuation by new investor Ribbit Capital, with continued support from existing backer a16z, amongst others.

About The Role

Valon is rebuilding the mortgage servicing industry from the ground up. We're looking for a Data Implementation Manager to join our team and help us coordinate and launch complex data workstreams as part of our enterprise deployments that will revolutionize how mortgage servicers operate.

In this role, you'll be instrumental in coordinating efforts across multiple internal teams (data, deployment strategy, engineering, product) and numerous client stakeholders, ensuring seamless communication, and driving the successful delivery of our most critical initiatives.

Within Mortgage Servicing, data is the lifeblood of a company’s day to day operations. There are substantial reporting requirements and a strong business need for robust internal controls. Data is one of the primary drivers to the quality of overall servicing operations and operating efficiency.

What You’ll Do

Lead End-to-End Data Migration: Lead data workstreams on client engagements to ensure data is properly migrated and critical reports and data assets are ready for go-live.
Drive Cross-Functional Coordination: Facilitate effective communication and collaboration between data, deployment strategy, engineering, product, and other stakeholders to ensure alignment and shared understanding.
Optimize Deployment Processes: Proactively identify and implement process improvements to drive efficiency, predictability, and scalability as we grow our deployment motion.
Manage Complex Stakeholder Dynamics: Organize, structure, and drive complex deployment workstreams. Proactively communicate program status, risks, and dependencies to all relevant stakeholders, ensuring transparency and alignment.
Mitigate Risks and Resolve Issues: Identify potential roadblocks and actively work to resolve technical, operational, and organizational challenges that may impact program delivery.
Define and Track Metrics: Establish clear success metrics for programs and regularly track progress, providing data-driven insights to inform decision-making.

What You'll Bring

5+ years of experience as an Implementation Manager, Customer Success Manager, or PM in a fast-paced, complex software development environment.
Experience at companies deploying software, AI, or technology at large enterprises. Experience with long-term (6+ month) implementation or business transformation projects is a plus.
Proven track record of successfully delivering large-scale, cross-functional technical programs.

jobs.title: Regulatory Implementation Manager
jobs.description:
Medica is a nonprofit health plan with more than a million members that serves communities in Minnesota, Nebraska, Wisconsin, Missouri, and beyond. We deliver personalized health care experiences and partner closely with providers to ensure members are genuinely cared for.

We're a team that owns our work with accountability, makes data-driven decisions, embraces continuous learning, and celebrates collaboration — because success is a team sport. It's our mission to be there in the moments that matter most for our members and employees. Join us in creating a community of connected care, where coordinated, quality service is the norm and every member feels valued.

The Regulatory Implementation Manager provides enterprise leadership for complex, cross-functional regulatory implementation initiatives. This role translates emerging regulatory requirements, legislation, and compliance guidance into actionable enterprise strategies, implementation plans, governance structures, and operational requirements.

The Regulatory Implementation Manager works in close partnership with the Director and coordinates execution across Compliance, Legal, Public Affairs, Information Technology, Marketing, Product, and other business functions. The role assesses regulatory and business impacts, identifies risks and dependencies, establishes implementation priorities, and advises senior leaders on regulatory implementation strategy, organizational readiness, resource requirements, risks, and decisions requiring executive action.

In this role, you will establish consistent regulatory implementation standards, governance practices, decision rights, operating guardrails, and reporting mechanisms supporting timely, sustainable, and well-controlled execution. The role also provides enterprise oversight of Medicare Marketing Materials and serves as a subject-matter resource for regulatory change management, implementation strategy, and organizational readiness. Performs other duties as assigned.

Key Accountabilities

Management & Leadership
Leads the Regulatory Implementation team and establishes clear accountabilities, priorities, performance expectations, and operating rhythms
Coaches and develops staff, defines team roles and responsibilities, and allocates resources to meet enterprise regulatory priorities
Builds a culture of accountability, collaboration, sound judgment, and service excellence

Regulatory Strategy & Impact Assessment
Provides strategic regulatory implementation guidance across Medica
Proactively assesses and communicates new regulatory requirements, legislation, and compliance bulletins on enterprise implications
Interprets requirements, identifies business impacts, priorities, risks, and resource needs, and develops recommendations for enterprise implementation

Implementation Strategy & Design
Leads the development of enterprise implementation strategies, operating models, readiness activities, and delivery approaches for complex regulatory initiatives
Coordinates business and technology dependencies and ensures regulatory requirements are translated into executable and sustainable operational changes
Monitors implementation progress, risks, resource requirements, and organizational readiness through completion

Medicare Marketing Materials Oversight
Responsible for oversight of Medicare Marketing Materials regulatory requirements and implementation
Establishes governance, review processes, controls, and accountability to support compliant and timely development, review, approval, and submission activities
Partners with Legal, Compliance, Marketing, Product, and other stakeholders to identify risks, resolve issues, and ensure regulatory readiness

Regulatory Expertise & Knowledge Sharing
Builds and advances organizational capability in regulatory implementation through standards, training, lessons learned, and knowledge sharing
Coach teams and implementation professionals on regulatory interpretation, governance, and execution
Promotes consistent application of enterprise practices and incorporates insights from regulatory developments into team and organizational priorities

Enterprise Governance & Operating Model
Establishes enterprise governance, decision rights, implementation standards, and operational guardrails for regulatory initiatives, including reporting
Defines roles and responsibilities across Compliance and business partners to support consistent and accountable execution
Develops and maintains the enterprise Regulatory Implementation roadmap and governance framework

Required Qualifications

Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience in related field
7+ years of work experience beyond degree
Demonstrated experience leading and developing teams and influencing cross-functional partners
Strong knowledge of healthcare regulations and compliance requirements and the ability to interpret and apply regulatory guidance
Experience developing implementation strategies, governance practices, roadmaps, budgets, resource plans, and risk mitigation strategies
Previous experience overseeing regulatory requirements affecting Medicare Marketing Materials

Preferred Qualifications

Strong leadership, communication, problem-solving, analytical, and decision-making skills
Demonstrated ability to partner effectively with Information Technology and business leaders on complex enterprise initiatives
Highest standard of ethics, accountability, discipline, and professionalism

This position is an Office role, which requires an employee to work onsite, on average, 3 days per week. We are open to candidates located near one of the following office locations: Minnetonka, MN, Madison, WI, St. Louis, MO, or Omaha, NE.

The full salary grade for this position is $88,800 - $152,300. While the full salary grade is provided, the typical hiring salary range for this role is expected to be between $88,800 - $133,245. Annual salary range placement will depend on a variety of factors including, but not limited to, education, work experience, applicable certifications and/or licensure, the position's scope and responsibility, internal pay equity and external market salary data.  In addition to base compensation, this position may be eligible for incentive plan compensation in addition to base salary. Medica offers a generous total rewards package that includes competitive medical, dental, vision, PTO, Holidays, paid volunteer time off, 401K contributions, caregiver services and many other benefits to support our employees.

The compensation and benefits information is provided as of the date of this posting. Medica’s compensation and benefits are subject to change at any time, with or without notice, subject to applicable law.

Eligibility to work in the US:
Medica does not offer work visa sponsorship for this role. All candidates must be legally authorized to work in the United States at the time of application. Employment is contingent on verification of identity and eligibility to work in the United States.

We are an Equal Opportunity employer, where all qualified candidates receive consideration for employment indiscriminate of race, religion, ethnicity, national origin, citizenship, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability, genetic information, or any other protected characteristic.

UCBEnvironmental is a family of companies focused on Sustainable Sustainability™. Through our five distinct divisions: UsedCardboardBoxes.com, UCBPalletSolutions, UCBOrganicWaste, UCBTrading and UCBZeroWaste… we service many of the largest, most trusted brands in the country!

We partner with the world leading companies to implement our proven methodology to reduce waste by focusing on the origin of waste (inside the building) as well as the processing of waste (outside the building). Our comprehensive programs include waste reduction, recycling, reuse, resale as well as de-packaging, digesting, composting and/or waste-to energy (WTE). UCBZeroWaste offers a (no-cost) comprehensive waste audit in order to quantify the financial and environmental opportunity.

• Competitive Salary

Own the end-to-end program planning and execution for robot pilot deployments—defining scope, schedule, resource needs, risk mitigations, and success criteria from site readiness through go-live and steady-state handover.

Establish program metrics, KPIs, and reporting mechanisms to provide leadership visibility into deployment health, team capacity, and NRE milestone progress.

Coordinate vendor and contractor engagements for outsourced tooling/fixture development, managing SOWs, timelines, and deliverable quality.

7+ years of working directly with engineering teams experience
Experience managing programs across cross functional teams, building processes and coordinating release schedules

5+ years of project management disciplines including scope, schedule, budget, quality, along with risk and critical path management experience
Experience defining KPI's/SLA's used to drive multi-million dollar businesses and reporting to senior leadership
