new_jobs.description:
At Associated Bank we strive to create an inclusive culture where different perspectives are valued and recognized as strengths critical to our success. If you thrive in an environment where your growth and development are encouraged and supported, then Associated Bank may be the right place for you.

Associated Bank requires you to directly represent yourself and your own experiences during the recruiting and hiring process. Associated Bank conducts a thorough background check on all new hires.

Role Summary

The Project Manager is responsible for leading and coordinating small to medium-sized business projects while ensuring successful execution throughout the project lifecycle. This role serves as a key liaison among business partners, leadership, project teams, and third-party vendors, driving projects to completion while balancing scope, timeline, cost, and quality. The Project Manager continues to build expertise in project management and develops a deeper understanding of the business areas they support.

Key Accountabilities

Lead cross-functional teams in the successful execution and implementation of business projects.
Develop and maintain project plans, timelines, and status reporting to ensure projects remain on track and stakeholders stay informed.
Identify, assess, and address project risks, issues, and changing requirements to support successful outcomes.
Manage project scope, schedules, resources, and budgets to achieve project objectives.
Support all phases of the project lifecycle, including requirements gathering, testing, design reviews, change management, and production readiness activities.
Plan and coordinate multiple interrelated tasks and initiatives based on business value, scope, schedule, and resource requirements.
Conduct research and analysis to define requirements, evaluate feasibility, and support high-quality project execution.
Partner with vendors and third parties throughout selection, contract review, and project delivery processes.

Required

Education & Experience

Bachelor’s degree in Business or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
2-4 years of experience in banking, business, or project management.
Knowledge and exposure to fundamental project management theories, principles, and concepts.
Demonstrated ability to manage projects, prioritize competing demands, and adapt to changing business needs.
Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.

Why You’ll Love Working Here

This role offers the opportunity to work on meaningful business initiatives while developing your project management expertise and expanding your organizational knowledge. You'll collaborate with cross-functional teams, build strong business relationships, and contribute to projects that drive business success.

Apply today to make an impact.

Personal banking, loan, investment and insurance benefits.

Job Description:

Technical Consulting Principal Project Manager

The Broadcom Mainframe Software Division (MSD) is looking for a Principal level IT Technical Project Manager to direct complex, high-stake cross functional software migration and related projects, typically overseeing portfolios related to program level engagements.

This role is related to MSD Technical Consulting Services billable engagements for large, diverse Fortune 500 companies. The Principal Project Manager defines governance and strategy, identifies and manages stakeholders, creates formal kickoff deliverables, builds project schedules, manages budgets, risks and issues provides expert leadership with a proven track record of successful execution managing mainframe software projects.

Ability to measure projects and independently drive execution and own responsibility for overall success of projects with experience documenting projects as reference/success stories. Accomplished project delivery is the key performance metric for this role.

Key Responsibilities

Strategic Direction & Leadership: Driving large-scale, complex projects from inception to implementation, ensuring alignment with company goals.
Project Governance: Creating and implementing project policies, procedures, and quality control standards.
Financial & Risk Management: Establishing budgets, controlling costs, forecasting expenditures, and managing risk mitigation strategies.
Stakeholder Management: Communicating project status, risks, and ROI to executive leadership, while managing relationships with clients and internal partners.
Process Improvement: Analyzing operational efficiency and developing solutions, to streamline workflows.
Team Leadership: Mentoring and guiding project teams, delegating tasks, and managing Broadcom and customer project resources.

Required Skills And Qualifications

Experience: Bachelors in business, engineering, or a related field; certifications like PMP (Project Management Professional) are often preferred or 8+ years of related experience or Masters degree and 6+ years of related experience
Requires 6+ years of project management experience, often with a focus on cross-functional, large-scale projects.
1-3+ years of Mainframe Software project management experience required.
Technical Proficiency: Advanced knowledge of project management tools, databases, and Microsoft Office (Excel, PowerPoint, MS Project).
Leadership/Soft Skills: Excellent communication, strategic thinking, negotiation, and conflict resolution skills.

Certification: PMP Certification or equivalent experience is preferred.

Compensation And Benefits

The annual base salary range for this position is USD 100,000.00 To USD 160,000.00

As a valued member of our team, you'll be eligible for a discretionary annual bonus and the opportunity to receive not only a competitive new hire equity grant, but also annual equity awards, connecting your success directly to the company's growth. All subject to relevant plan documents and award agreements.

Broadcom offers a competitive and comprehensive benefits package: Medical, dental and vision plans, 401(K) participation including company matching, Employee Stock Purchase Program (ESPP), Employee Assistance Program (EAP), company paid holidays, paid sick leave and vacation time. new_jobs.title: Project Manager – Technical and Field Operations
new_jobs.description:
About Draganfly

Draganfly Inc. (the “Company”) has been a recognized technology leader within the commercial UAV space for over two decades. We helped establish the commercial market & adoption of multi-rotor helicopters for public safety, agriculture, aerial imaging, & more. As a leader who helped shape the industry, Draganfly’s focus is on the sale of drone products and services, contract engineering & custom integration product development, and health monitoring products and services.

Additional information on our expertise, projects, and culture can be found at https://draganfly.com/

Draganfly is seeking a Project Manager to lead the planning and execution of customer-facing, technical, and cross-functional projects across the organization. This role will serve as a primary point of coordination between customers, Engineering, Operations, Sales, Field Operations, Logistics, and other internal stakeholders to ensure projects are clearly defined, properly resourced, effectively managed, and successfully delivered.

The ideal candidate is an experienced project manager with the technical aptitude to work effectively alongside engineering and technical teams without needing to serve as the subject matter expert. This individual will manage multiple concurrent projects, communicate directly with customers and partners, coordinate cross-functional teams, and maintain strong execution throughout the project lifecycle. This role reports directly to the PMO Lead and works closely with Program Managers, functional leaders, technical teams, subject-matter experts, cross-functional teams, and Project Coordinators.

Key Responsibilities

Project Leadership & Delivery

Lead assigned customer-facing, technical, integration, special, and cross-functional projects from initiation through delivery and closeout.
Establish and maintain project objectives, scope, schedules, milestones, risks, dependencies, stakeholders, and acceptance criteria.
Develop project plans aligned with the complexity, risk, and delivery requirements of each initiative.
Maintain accountability for assigned projects while coordinating work across multiple functional teams.
Monitor project progress, resource requirements, schedules, and deliverables to support successful execution.
Identify and address project risks, constraints, schedule impacts, and resource requirements in collaboration with the appropriate stakeholders.
Manage multiple concurrent projects while maintaining clear priorities and consistent stakeholder communication.
Support internal Engineering projects as portfolio capacity permits.

Customer & Stakeholder Management

Serve as the primary project-management point of contact for assigned customers, partners, and external stakeholders.
Facilitate customer and technical meetings to define requirements, integration needs, delivery expectations, and acceptance criteria.
Translate technical project progress into clear customer-facing updates while enabling Engineering personnel to remain focused on technical execution.
Coordinate with Engineering and technical subject matter experts to obtain accurate information and resolve customer questions.
Communicate project updates, changes, decisions, and milestones professionally and transparently.
Maintain strong relationships with customers and internal stakeholders throughout the project lifecycle.

Cross-Functional Coordination

Coordinate project activities across Engineering, Operations, Field Operations, Sales/Business Development, Logistics, Procurement, and other functional teams.
Establish clear ownership of project deliverables, actions, dependencies, and handoffs.
Facilitate internal project meetings to review progress, priorities, risks, and upcoming milestones.
Coordinate technical requirements between customers and internal teams while supporting efficient use of technical resources.
Ensure appropriate stakeholders are engaged at each stage of the project lifecycle.
Support the execution of special initiatives that span multiple organizational functions.

Demo, Training & Event Oversight

Maintain project-level accountability for assigned demonstrations, customer trainings, trade shows, and operational events.
Coordinate personnel, equipment, logistics, customer requirements, and readiness activities leading up to execution.
Partner with Project Coordinators to ensure event intake, scheduling, calendar management, readiness tracking, logistics follow-up, and administrative requirements are completed.
Monitor project readiness, customer requirements, schedule alignment, and operational planning.
Support pre-event and customer planning activities as required.

Who Are You Really?

You are a highly organized project leader who can manage multiple priorities, stakeholders, and workstreams in a fast-paced environment.
You communicate clearly and professionally with customers, partners, technical teams, and senior stakeholders.
You take ownership, exercise sound judgment, follow through on commitments, and solve problems proactively.
You can influence and coordinate cross-functional contributors who do not directly report to you.

Required Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in project management, business administration, engineering, operations, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and relevant experience.
Demonstrated experience managing projects involving multiple stakeholders, functional teams, or workstreams.
Strong project-management fundamentals, including scope, schedule, risk, dependency, stakeholder, and issue management.
Strong written and verbal communication skills.
Demonstrated ability to communicate professionally with customers and external stakeholders.
Ability to organize and manage multiple concurrent priorities in a fast-paced environment.
Strong judgment, ownership, follow-through, and problem-solving skills.
Ability to influence and coordinate personnel who do not directly report to the Project Manager.
Ability to understand technical discussions sufficiently to identify requirements, dependencies, risks, and follow-up actions.
Comfortable using project-management and collaboration software.
Ability and willingness to travel as required in support of customer engagements, project execution, demonstrations, integrations, validation activities, and other business needs.

Preferred Qualifications & Certifications

PMP certification or demonstrated progress toward PMP certification.
Experience working in aerospace, unmanned aircraft systems (UAS), robotics, engineering, or another technical environment.
Experience managing technical integration, product-development, or customer-delivery projects.
Experience working directly with engineers and technical subject matter experts.
Experience supporting government, military, public-safety, or enterprise customers.
Experience using ClickUp or a comparable project-management platform.
General technical aptitude across mechanical, electrical, software, communications, aviation, or related technology areas.

Compensation Package

Competitive salary: $80,000–$100,000 USD
Health Coverage Reimbursement: We reimburse the cost of your existing or preferred healthcare plan (amount varies depending on family size).
401(k) program with employer matching
Generous time-off program, including vacation, wellness days, and the week off between Christmas and New Year’s.
Professional development support, including assistance in obtaining or maintaining role-relevant certifications (e.g., PMP certification, where applicable).

At Draganfly Innovations, you’ll join a collaborative team that values innovation, curiosity, and continuous improvement. We’re in an exciting growth phase, scaling our technologies, product lines, and teams as we continue to shape the future of UAV innovation. Joining us now means becoming part of a company with deep roots in the industry - and bold ambitions for what comes next.

You’ll have the opportunity to make a meaningful impact, work on diverse and cutting‑edge projects, and grow your skills alongside passionate experts. We offer competitive compensation, strong benefits, and a supportive environment where your contributions truly matter. Here, you won’t just join a company - you’ll help build what comes next. To be considered for this role, you must reside in one of the following states: Alabama, California, Colorado, Georgia, Iowa, Maryland, Michigan, Minnesota, Mississippi, Missouri, New Jersey, New York, North Carolina, Oregon, Pennsylvania, South Carolina, Texas, Utah, Virginia, or Washington.

This is a full-time role that can be worked remotely, however, collaboration with teammates centered in the Pacific time zone will be essential. No third-party agencies, please .

The Role and Responsibilities

Cross Domain Program Coordination & Support
Support compliance teams in managing and updating feature inventories for multiple compliance programs.
Help organize regular reviews of new features and experiences; assist in capturing decisions and tracking follow-up actions.
Partner with engineering teams to help ensure they have the right information and resources to complete required compliance reviews.
Identify opportunities to streamline cross domain workflows and contribute suggestions to improve operational efficiency.
Engage with compliance area owners to help make sure that each area is ready for release.
Maintain clear communication channels with stakeholders, providing regular updates on bug resolution progress.

Reporting & Stakeholder Communication

Capture clear meeting notes, decisions, next steps, and action items to help maintain alignment across all participating teams.

Risk & Confidentiality

Required Qualifications

4–10 years of experience in program or project management, ideally supporting compliance, governance, regulatory, risk, accessibility, privacy, or similar cross functional initiatives.
Strong analytical and organizational skills, with the ability to break down complex requirements into structured tasks for engineering and product teams.
Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with comfort working across diverse groups and levels.
Familiarity with Azure DevOps (ADO) and Power BI, or similar tools, for tracking and reporting.
Ability to learn quickly across multiple compliance domains and support SMEs, even without deep specialization in any one domain.
Experience contributing to process improvements, workflow optimization, or compliance enablement programs.

DTE is one of the nation’s largest diversified energy companies. Our electric and gas companies have fueled our customer’s homes and Michigan’s progress for more than a century. When you join us, you’ll be part of a team that welcomes, recognizes, and celebrates differences and values everyone’s health, safety, and wellbeing. Are you ready to make that kind of difference? Bring your energy to DTE. Together, we can achieve great things.

Testing Required:
Not Applicable

This role is hybrid, with an established schedule of in-person work required at an assigned work location. Any remote work is expected to be performed from an employee’s primary residence, unless allowed (or prohibited) through the Company’s remote work guidelines.

Yes – Must be available to perform a primary assignment in support of DTE’s emergency response to storms or other events that impact service to our customers.

Job Summary

Responsible for the design and construction and/or commissioning of intermediate to large-size capital renewable projects. May be asked to train and mentor more associate project managers. Uses formal project management methods to coordinate project team activities including defining the scope of work, scheduling, estimating and engineering. Manage costs and change control procedures and ensure project close-out and documentation processes are complete. Types of projects include solar, wind, and energy storage, with hands-on construction assignments in collaboration with multiple internal and external stakeholders. Span of control: this is an individual contributor job.

Key Accountabilities

Develops renewable energy project scope and coordinates a team of specialists who provide project schedule, cost estimates and engineering specifications for capital projects.
Ensures the completion of engineering, design, installation, testing, commissioning into service and project closeout.
Responsible for renewable project expenditures and the cost-effective procurement of labor, equipment and materials: coordinates with authorized company representatives in conducting bid meetings and reviews, supplier selections and evaluations; determines contracting strategy congruent with labor utilization strategies.
Supports daily management of on-site construction activities, working with contractors and service providers, including timely completion of work within approved budget.
Responsible for meeting key performance metrics including scope, schedule, and budget for projects and/or programs.
Communicate as the main point of contact to provide updates on project statuses to all stakeholders and engage appropriate stakeholders in decisions to ensure a clear understanding of direction and expectations.
Serve as the main liaison with internal organizations, plants, suppliers, trade labor organizations (unions), etc. May support contract administration services for blanket orders or other subcontractors and vendors.
Evaluates conditions and consults on solutions to control project risk.
Ensures compliance with safety, environmental and regulatory requirements.
Identifies and obtains regulatory approval for the construction and operation of new renewable energy projects required.
Mentor and train more associate level project managers, project engineers, and/or co-op students

Minimum Education & Experience Requirements

This is a multi-track base requirement job; education and experience requirements can be satisfied through one of the following three options:

Master’s or bachelor’s degree in engineering, engineering technology, architecture, construction management, project management, or business/management and 6 years of project management experience inclusive of 2 years with large scale construction or utility project related experience, with 6 months of project management experience in renewable energy such as wind, solar, and energy storage capital projects.
Associate degree in engineering, engineering technology, architecture/technical design, project management, business/management, construction management, or construction technology and 8 years of related project management experience inclusive of 2 years with large scale construction or utility project related experience, with 6 months of project management experience in renewable energy such as wind, solar, and energy storage capital projects.
High School Diploma or equivalent and 10 years of related project management experience inclusive of 2 years with large scale construction or utility project related experience, with 6 months of project management experience in renewable energy such as wind, solar, and energy storage capital projects.

Preferred

Project Management Professional (PMP) Certification
Renewable or utility experience
Large scale construction experience
Experience with overseeing O&M 3rd party service providers

Other Qualifications

Traveling is required up to 90% of the time.
Experienced with P6 Primavera
Analysis of metrics on project deadlines, budgets, and deliverables
Experience presenting strategic plans to all levels of leadership, including senior leaders.
Hands-on experience in managing renewable energy projects or large-scale projects.
Proficiency in handling projects involving multi-disciplinary teams and many stakeholders.

Shapes program improvement strategies, leveraging best practices to drive transformational change and optimize processes across multiple teams. Shapes technical program improvement strategies, leveraging best practices to drive transformational change and optimize processes across multiple teams. – Designs and shapes the strategy for product or service delivery, ensuring alignment with the third party, security, export, and accessibility compliance requirements.

– Integrates program demands and resourcing.

– Leads the transformation and optimization of processes to ensure the highest reliability and resilience of products or services.

– Utilizes technical knowledge to identify and manage program dependencies and risks.

– Supports rapid response to escalations, coordinating within team and communicating to senior team members to assess risk, determine mitigation strategies, and execute the optimal proposed path to resolution.

– Shapes overall planning activities, ensuring alignment with enterprise architecture.

– Defines and enforces delivery standards and guidelines, ensuring security, scalability, and alignment with best practices.

– Develops Line of Business (LOB) strategies for change management and/or incident response to enhance operational efficiency.

Program Oversight - Strategy and Decision-Making:

– Leads the alignment of priorities with customers, service, and stakeholder teams through regular reporting to stakeholders and senior leadership.

– Establishes scope and milestones, aligning to the broader program plan and company strategies and goals, managing efforts between cross-functional teams to deliver programs or services.

– Leads efforts to define and monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) and measurement methods for LOB performance.

– Develops and communicates a comprehensive and strategic communication strategy of highly complex objectives to partners and customers.

Program Oversight - Program and Operations Management:

– Shapes and leads both technical and non-technical programs and highly complex, cross-organizational programs impacting products and business.

– Guides and mentors program staff (e.g., development, release management, customer success), providing expert technical support and strategic direction on removing barriers, including risks and issues in workflows.

– Provides guidance on developing and maintaining comprehensive program documentation (e.g., status reports, program plans) and develops risk mitigation strategies.

– Ensures attention to detail, including security and quality, in program management, from planning to execution and reporting.

– Chairs regular program status meetings, fostering collaboration and driving effective communication across teams and leaders.

– Partners with leadership to set service level agreements (SLAs) and productivity benchmarks aligned with long-term business goals.

– Shapes and leads forecasting program demands, funding, and resourcing.

– Leads the deployment of change management for programs, such as priority, scope, scheduling, development, requirement changes, and support.

Program Oversight - Risk Management:

– Drives the management of and responses to issues, bottlenecks, and risks, serving as a point of escalation for all issues.

– Develops plans based on the results of cost assessments, benefits analysis, and return on investment (ROI) to improve decision-making and risk mitigation strategies.

– Makes strategic decisions, balancing business needs, technical constraints, and long-term goals.

– Removes critical blockers for the program and determines optimal technical and resource options to drive the successful delivery and adoption of solutions.

Process Efficiency - Process Optimization:

– Shapes program improvement strategies, leveraging best practices to drive transformational change and optimize processes across the LOB.

– Leads the development and optimization of program objectives and workflows, while orchestrating the deployment of cross-functional solutions to address complex business problems.

– Collaborates with management to innovate and optimize processes and procedures to drive achievement of LOB goals.

Process Efficiency - Continuous Improvement:

– Establishes and champions best practices for leveraging data insights at scale, influencing senior leadership decisions.

– Leads the development of innovative business-critical improvements to the solution's availability and reliability.

– Iterates processes based on feedback and KPIs, analyzing results through retrospectives.

– Defines requirements and configurations of existing and new development tools, where applicable.

– Leads process improvements across the LOB, working with senior leaders to implement team-wide efficiency-driven solutions.

– Communicates strategic program updates and insights to leadership teams, shaping decisions at the LOB level.

– Develops and refines engagement approaches for key stakeholders, ensuring informed decision-making at scale to improve program planning and execution.

Collaboration and Program Leadership - Program Leadership:

– Shapes and leads programs to optimize organizational efficiency.

– Provides visionary technical direction and mentorship to cross-functional teams.

– Drives transformative change at all levels of the LOB, from initiation through delivery, while ensuring alignment with strategic goals.

– Ensures that the program team and other stakeholders are aligned with the program goals and motivated, identifying and addressing conflicts and issues.

Data and Analysis:

Anticipates and plans for shifts in resources or timelines based on changing business priorities, ensuring optimal outcomes.

new_jobs.title: Staff Technical Program Manager, IT Audit & Governance
new_jobs.description:
We're looking for a senior, hands-on leader to own IT audit and governance across all of our applications, infrastructure, and systems. You'll be accountable for keeping IT audit-ready every day: SOX ITGCs and ITACs, plus the broader audit and governance obligations that touch the technology stack (SOC reports, ISO, security and regulatory audits).

This role is about accountability and execution. You'll work with cross-functional IT leaders across Infrastructure, Engineering, Security, Cloud, Enterprise Applications, and Business Systems to make sure controls are owned, operated, evidenced, and remediated on time. You'll also be the primary IT liaison to Internal Audit, Finance/SOX PMO, and external auditors. You operate independently, influence without authority, and can speak credibly with an engineer about a CI/CD pipeline and with the CAO about a deficiency.

We're looking to speak with candidates based in Palo Alto or New York City for our hybrid working model.

What You'll Do

Own audit and governance across all IT

Own the audit and governance program across all IT applications, infrastructure, cloud platforms, and supporting systems
Maintain a complete inventory of systems, owners, and applicable audit and compliance obligations (SOX, SOC 1/SOC 2, ISO 27001, and other regulatory or customer requirements)
Build and run an IT audit calendar that coordinates SOX, internal audit, external audit, and compliance activities to reduce duplicate asks and audit fatigue
Establish governance standards, policies, and control frameworks that apply consistently across IT

Drive accountability and execution with IT leaders

Partner with cross-functional IT leaders to assign clear control and remediation ownership, with defined deadlines and escalation paths
Run regular governance forums and control health reviews with IT leadership, reporting status, risks, and overdue items
Hold teams accountable for timely control execution, evidence quality, and issue closure, escalating early when commitments slip
Translate audit and compliance requirements into practical work that engineering and infrastructure teams can adopt without slowing delivery

Own ITGC and ITAC compliance

Own the end-to-end SOX IT program: scoping inputs, control design, ownership, evidence, readiness testing, and issue management
Maintain the ITGC framework (access management, change management, IT operations, SDLC) across all in-scope applications, databases, operating systems, and cloud infrastructure
Own ITAC strategy and coverage with Finance and business-system owners: automated controls, configurations, interfaces, calculations, and approval workflows
Own IPE/report validation, ITAC baselines, and segregation of duties (SoD) across ERP and key financial applications

Design, operate, and strengthen controls

Design controls that are engineered into IT workflows (ticketing, CI/CD, IAM, CMDB) rather than layered on manually
Run readiness and self-assessment testing ahead of Internal Audit and external auditor testing
Rationalize overlapping controls across frameworks so one control and one piece of evidence can satisfy multiple requirements
Drive automation and continuous control monitoring to reduce manual effort and audit burden
Manage SOC 1/SOC 2 report reviews, CUECs, and third-party/vendor control dependencies

Drive remediation and issue management

Own the issue lifecycle across IT, from identification and root cause through remediation plan, validation, and closure
Prepare management's response to audit findings and provide the IT perspective on deficiency severity with Finance, Legal, and Internal Audit
Report control health and remediation status to IT leadership, the CAO, and the Audit Committee as needed

Be the IT face to auditors and the business

Serve as primary IT contact for Internal Audit and external auditors on scope, walkthroughs, evidence requests, and reliance strategy
Coordinate PBC requests, evidence standards, and timelines across IT teams
Train and enable control owners and IT leaders on audit requirements, evidence quality, and their responsibilities

Lead and elevate the program

Set standards for control documentation, evidence, and issue management across IT
Mentor analysts and guide co-source or outsourced resources
Contribute to emerging governance areas such as AI/emerging technology

What You'll Bring

Required

8-12+ years of experience in IT audit, SOX compliance, IT governance, or technology risk (Big 4, internal audit, or in-house IT GRC)
Deep, hands-on experience with SOX 404 ITGCs and ITACs in a public company
Working knowledge of COSO, COBIT, and PCAOB AS 2201, and how external auditors approach IT reliance and ITAC testing
Experience across modern technology environments: cloud (AWS/Azure/GCP), SaaS, ERP (e.g., Oracle, NetSuite, SAP), infrastructure, and identity/access platforms
Familiarity with other frameworks and audits (SOC 1/SOC 2, ISO 27001, NIST) and how to harmonize them
Proven track record of owning programs end-to-end and driving accountability and execution across multiple teams and senior leaders without direct authority
Excellent communication and executive presence, including negotiating with auditors and briefing senior leadership
Bachelor's degree in Information Systems, Accounting, Computer Science, or a related field

Preferred

CISA, CISSP, CIA, CPA, or equivalent certification
Experience with GRC and audit tools (e.g., AuditBoard, ServiceNow GRC, Workiva, Archer)
Data analytics skills (SQL, Python, Power BI/Tableau) for full-population testing and control monitoring
Experience in high-growth, SaaS, or technology company environments
Familiarity with DevOps/CI-CD, infrastructure-as-code, and change management in agile environments

What Success Looks Like

First 90 days: Map the IT landscape, systems, control owners, and audit obligations. Build relationships with IT leaders, Finance, Internal Audit, and external auditors. Identify the top gaps, ownership issues, and quick wins.
6 months: Stand up a governance cadence with IT leaders, with clear ownership and on-time execution. Complete a full readiness cycle with controls evidenced on time and no surprises from auditors.
12 months: Reduce control count and manual effort through rationalization and automation, close prior-year findings, and establish a scalable, IT-owned audit and governance program with a consolidated audit calendar and framework

Job Description Summary

** NOTE A COVER LETTER IS REQUIRED FOR CONSIDERATION **

The Transportation Research Board (TRB), a division of the National Academies of Sciences, Engineering, and Medicine, provides leadership in transportation innovation through objective, evidence-based research and convenes experts from government, industry, and academia to address complex transportation challenges. Within TRB, the Cooperative Research Programs (CRP) are applied research programs—including the National Cooperative Highway Research Program (NCHRP), Transit Cooperative Research Program (TCRP), Airport Cooperative Research Program (ACRP), and others—that develop practical, implementable solutions to current and emerging transportation issues through stakeholder-driven research and collaboration.

The Senior Program Manager - Planning and Environment provides senior-level program management for a complex and diverse portfolio of cooperative transportation research projects. This role has no direct supervisory responsibilities and combines portfolio-level accountability with hands-on management of complex and high-visibility research projects.

Reporting to the Program Director, the Senior Program Manager exercises substantial independent judgment in managing and overseeing project portfolios, resolving complex issues, and engaging with volunteers, sponsors, research agencies, and stakeholders. The role is accountable for ensuring research quality, operational effectiveness, and timely delivery across multiple topic areas, while aligning project activities with division priorities.

Job Description

Transportation Disciplines

This role involves leading and facilitating research efforts in collaboration with expert panels across diverse transportation topics for Panning and Environment.

Responsibilities

Project Panel Meeting Planning & Support

Review panel nominations and coordinate the formation of project panels.
Facilitate project panel meetings, support panel chairs, and follow up with notes and action items from panel meetings.
Prepare materials, schedules, and documentation needed to support effective panel deliberations and project decisions.
Document panel input, decisions, and recommendations to support timely project implementation and follow-up.

Proposal Development & Research Agency Selection

Work with prospective proposers to resolve matters related to submission of acceptable proposals.
Evaluate research proposals for technical merit and participate in the process of selecting research agencies.
Support fair, objective, and well-documented proposal review and research agency selection processes.

Research Planning & Contract Coordination

Become thoroughly familiar with selected research plans and work with research agencies and project panels to develop detailed working plans to accomplish project objectives.
Work with administrative offices to provide information necessary for contract negotiation and execution.
Clarify project objectives, technical expectations, schedules, deliverables, and performance requirements with research agencies and project panels.

Contract & Project Management

Assemble and submit the complete contract package, including all required documents, in accordance with CRP processes.
Manage contracts by establishing clear project objectives and technical approaches for achieving project goals.
Visit research agencies, as appropriate, to become familiar with their organizations and facilities, monitor work, and assess progress against project schedules.
Review monthly, quarterly, and other progress reports needed for administration of the program.
Prepare compliance reports that document project progress and assess research agency performance and accomplishments.

Project Monitoring & Quality Review

Conduct site visits, as appropriate.
Make critical reviews of project progress and recommend improvements when needed.
Review all types of reports that emanate from research for clarity, completeness, adherence to CRP format, and fulfillment of the approved research plan.
Make recommendations as to the acceptability of research products and deliverables.

Research Interpretation, Publication & Dissemination

Interpret project findings with respect to applicability for improving transportation practices.
Prepare research results digests and other derivative products.
Prepare forewords for use in published reports.
Make presentations on research findings at technical meetings and other professional forums.

Coordination & Program Support

Coordinate with appropriate agencies and subject-matter experts within assigned subject areas to ensure projects benefit from available knowledge.
Provide staff support to NCHRP oversight committee, American Association of State Highway and Transportation Officials (AASHTO) and the Federal Highway Administration (FHWA) in formulating the annual NCHRP research program by reviewing and evaluating problem statements submitted for research.
Work effectively with sponsors, volunteers, research agencies, administrative offices, and colleagues to support timely and high-quality delivery of NCHRP research.

Confidentiality:
Maintains confidentiality. Handles secure, privileged, sensitive, or confidential information with discretion and in accordance with organizational policies and procedures. Maintains strict confidence to prevent disclosure. Accesses such information strictly for work-related purposes, and ensures that it is securely stored, transmitted, and disposed of in compliance with organization guidelines. Ensures procedures are in place to safeguard confidentiality and prevent unauthorized disclosure. Provides ongoing training and guidance to team members to reinforce best practices in handling confidential information

Requirements

Required Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

Knowledge of cooperative or committee-driven research programs and familiarity with transportation research sponsors and policy environments.
Understanding of the National Academies’ mission, structure, and culture.
Strong organizational, analytical, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to manage complex portfolios and competing priorities.
Strong written, verbal, and interpersonal communication skills, with the ability to effectively engage stakeholders at all levels.
Ability to manage funding-related matters and high-risk or complex research initiatives.
Ability to operate with substantial independence, sound judgment, and discretion in a complex organizational environment.
Ability to solve complex problems involving significant variety and to serve as a resource to others in resolving issues.
Ability to work effectively in team-based settings and build and sustain collaborative relationships across departments and stakeholder groups.
Ability to perform effectively in complex, high-impact environments with multiple priorities and demands.

Minimum Education/Training Requirements

Master’s degree in a discipline relevant to transportation, highways, public policy, research management, or a closely related field; or a bachelor’s degree in a relevant discipline with significant professional experience demonstrating advanced subject matter expertise, management of complex projects or programs, and independent research, analysis, or policy development responsibilities.

Minimum Experience

Six years of related professional experience. Demonstrated impact on the advancement of science, transportation practice, or policy through the successful completion of National Academies activities or equivalent outside activities and through effective dissemination of these activities.
Significant experience managing applied research projects or programs.

Required Licenses, Certification or Registration: None

Any qualification to be considered equivalent, in lieu of stated minimum, requires the prior approval of the Office of Human Resources.

Other Details

Supervisory Responsibilities/Controls

Reports to the Program Director. Independently establishes goals and objectives. This position has no direct supervisory responsibilities.

Mental And Physical Capabilities

Ability to be visible on camera for meetings when remote.
Ability to use a computer and applicable hardware/software to perform responsibilities.
Ability to use multiple technology collaboration platforms, including collaboration tools. Examples: Microsoft Teams, Asana.
Ability to focus/concentrate on tasks and multi-task, when needed.
Begin work at the required time, per approved schedule.
Ability to lift/carry laptop and other mobile devices between work and home.
Ability to commute to work.
Ability to travel between National Academies’ facilities and offsite sponsor/partner locations.
Ability to work in different time zones, when travel is outside of current location, e.g., when traveling internationally.
Ability to perform work responsibilities onsite, where required.
Ability to interact in-person with multiple people and large groups.
Ability to work in a fast-paced environment and meet deadlines.

Work Environment

Hybrid office/telecommute environment; expected onsite percentage 60%. Occasional travel between National Academies’ facilities and to off-site meeting/sponsor locations.

Compensation & Benefits

Compensation offered to the selected candidate will be based on the candidate’s relevant knowledge, skills, and work experience, commensurate with compensation of current employees in comparable positions with similar knowledge, skills, and work experience, and subject to budget parameters. Schneider Electric has a meaningful opportunity for a Project Manager, preferably in Nashville
, to join a high-visibility cost-transformation program. This role offers direct exposure to senior leadership and the opportunity to orchestrate a complex portfolio from idea through execution.

About The NAM ZBB Program

North America Operations is launching a zero-based review of how we organize and what we spend. Rather than adjusting last year’s budget up or down, zero-based budgeting methodology rebuilds the cost base from the work that actually needs to be done. The program covers two areas: organization (who does what work, and how much capacity we need) and spend (what we buy, and why). The first wave covers project execution and strategy roles across our Business Units, along with non-headcount spend in selected cost centers, and builds on a successful pilot in another Schneider Electric region.

The program is run by a small dedicated team – a Program lead, a Finance lead and an HR lead – working alongside an external consulting partner for the initial projects and to build the capabilities. The team reports to a Steering Committee that includes NAM Senior management.

Role Overview

You will be the program integrator and single point of accountability to the Steering Committee. You will own the program cadence, partner interfaces and system of management—moving every initiative from idea to commitment and execution.

Responsibilities

Own the overall program governance, operating cadence, and management system, including Steering Committees, workshops, and executive decision forums.
Develop, maintain, and communicate integrated program roadmaps, milestones, interdependencies, risks, and mitigation plans in close connection to Finance and HR

Excellent planning, prioritization, dependency and risk-management capabilities.

new_jobs.title: Lead Principal Technical Program Manager
new_jobs.description:
Job Description

Partners with senior management and stakeholders to align priorities and goals using technical know-how in a fundamental engineering area or technical domain. Establishes scope and milestones for each aspect of a technical program, aligning to the broader program plan and company strategies and goals, managing efforts between cross-functional teams to deliver programs or services. Shapes and leads technical programs and highly complex, cross-organizational initiatives impacting products and business. Drives the management of and responses to issues, bottlenecks, and risks, serving as a point of escalation for all issues. Shapes program improvement strategies, leveraging best practices to drive transformational change and optimize processes across multiple teams. Shapes technical program improvement strategies, leveraging best practices to drive transformational change and optimize processes across multiple teams. Shapes technical collaboration across multiple teams, ensuring alignment of priorities and program goals. Provides expert technical guidance to shape and direct the automation of comprehensive reporting, leading collaboration with development teams to drive innovations in reports, dashboards, forecasts, and models for long-term technical program execution. Shapes the strategic direction of collaboration efforts as a technical liaison across stakeholder teams for high-impact technical programs.

Responsibilities

Key Responsibilities

Technical Management and Execution - Technical Management:

– Leverages technical knowledge to identify risks, manage scope, estimate program timelines, request feasibility, testing requirements, and determine appropriate resources.

– Designs and shapes the strategy for product or service delivery, ensuring alignment with the third party, security, export, and accessibility compliance requirements.

– Integrates program demands and resourcing.

– Leads rapid response to the most critical security escalations, coordinating across teams and departments and serving as the primary point of contact to executives to assess risk, determine comprehensive mitigation strategies, and ensure alignment and execution of the most effective path to resolution.

– Leads the transformation and optimization of processes to ensure the highest reliability and resilience of products or services.

Technical Management and Execution - Technical Strategy and Execution:

– Utilizes technical knowledge to identify and manage program dependencies and risks.

– Supports rapid response to escalations, coordinating within team and communicating to senior team members to assess risk, determine mitigation strategies, and execute the optimal proposed path to resolution.

– Shapes overall planning activities, ensuring alignment with enterprise architecture.

– Defines and enforces delivery standards and guidelines, ensuring security, scalability, and alignment with best practices.

– Develops Line of Business (LOB) strategies for change management and/or incident response to enhance operational efficiency.

Program Oversight - Strategy and Decision-Making:

– Leads the alignment of priorities with customers, service, and stakeholder teams through regular reporting to stakeholders and senior leadership.

– Establishes scope and milestones, aligning to the broader program plan and company strategies and goals, managing efforts between cross-functional teams to deliver programs or services.

– Leads efforts to define and monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) and measurement methods for LOB performance.

– Develops and communicates a comprehensive and strategic communication strategy of highly complex objectives to partners and customers.

Program Oversight - Program and Operations Management:

– Shapes and leads both technical and non-technical programs and highly complex, cross-organizational programs impacting products and business.

– Guides and mentors program staff (e.g., development, release management, customer success), providing expert technical support and strategic direction on removing barriers, including risks and issues in workflows.

– Provides guidance on developing and maintaining comprehensive program documentation (e.g., status reports, program plans) and develops risk mitigation strategies.

– Ensures attention to detail, including security and quality, in program management, from planning to execution and reporting.

– Chairs regular program status meetings, fostering collaboration and driving effective communication across teams and leaders.

– Partners with leadership to set service level agreements (SLAs) and productivity benchmarks aligned with long-term business goals.

– Shapes and leads forecasting program demands, funding, and resourcing.

– Leads the deployment of change management for programs, such as priority, scope, scheduling, development, requirement changes, and support.

Program Oversight - Risk Management:

– Drives the management of and responses to issues, bottlenecks, and risks, serving as a point of escalation for all issues.

– Develops plans based on the results of cost assessments, benefits analysis, and return on investment (ROI) to improve decision-making and risk mitigation strategies.

– Makes strategic decisions, balancing business needs, technical constraints, and long-term goals.

– Removes critical blockers for the program and determines optimal technical and resource options to drive the successful delivery and adoption of solutions.

Process Efficiency - Process Optimization:

– Shapes program improvement strategies, leveraging best practices to drive transformational change and optimize processes across the LOB.

– Leads the development and optimization of program objectives and workflows, while orchestrating the deployment of cross-functional solutions to address complex business problems.

– Collaborates with management to innovate and optimize processes and procedures to drive achievement of LOB goals.

Process Efficiency - Continuous Improvement:

– Champions LOB-wide integration of continuous improvement within programs, ensuring alignment of insights across many workstreams with business objectives and operational efficiency goals.

– Establishes and champions best practices for leveraging data insights at scale, influencing senior leadership decisions.

– Leads the development of innovative business-critical improvements to the solution's availability and reliability.

– Iterates processes based on feedback and KPIs, analyzing results through retrospectives.

– Defines requirements and configurations of existing and new development tools, where applicable.

Collaboration and Program Leadership - Cross Functional Collaboration:

– Shapes collaboration across multiple teams, ensuring alignment of priorities and program goals.

– Leads process improvements across the LOB, working with senior leaders to implement team-wide efficiency-driven solutions.

– Communicates strategic program updates and insights to leadership teams, shaping decisions at the LOB level.

– Develops and refines engagement approaches for key stakeholders, ensuring informed decision-making at scale to improve program planning and execution.

Collaboration and Program Leadership - Program Leadership:

– Shapes and leads programs to optimize organizational efficiency.

– Provides visionary technical direction and mentorship to cross-functional teams.

– Drives transformative change at all levels of the LOB, from initiation through delivery, while ensuring alignment with strategic goals.

– Ensures that the program team and other stakeholders are aligned with the program goals and motivated, identifying and addressing conflicts and issues.

Data and Analysis:

– Shapes and directs the automation of comprehensive reporting, collaborating with development teams to drive continuous improvement of reports, dashboards, forecasts, and models for program execution.

– Utilizes data insights to solve highly complex problems impacting the success of the program(s), including adherence to SLAs.

– Conducts analysis on a large number of data sources with high complexity, which may include competitive analysis, trend analysis, and KPI analysis, to drive data-informed decisions to support the program goals, presenting findings with immediate teams stakeholders.

Stakeholder Engagement:

– Shapes the strategic direction of collaboration efforts across stakeholder teams for high-impact programs.

– Serves as a trusted advisor to senior stakeholders, ensuring alignment between program priorities and business objectives.

– Defines strategies for enhancing customer engagement, aligning service offerings with evolving business needs.

– Drives large-scale product and process enhancements, influencing and guiding the LOB.

– Develops and presents advanced strategies to mitigate risks to customer satisfaction, assessing the impact of mitigation efforts on broader group objectives.

– Leads the alignment of varied priorities and Oracle commitments, ensuring optimal coverage and response to customer needs, minimizing organizational risk to programs.

Core Responsibilities

Planning & Execution:

– Manages and provides direction on timelines, deliverables, and budgets when applicable for critical high-impact projects or initiatives that impact the line of business, ensuring timely completion and adherence to requirements. Anticipates and plans for shifts in resources or timelines based on changing business priorities, ensuring optimal outcomes.

Collaboration & Partnership:

– Influences cross-functional leaders and external stakeholders to gain alignment on strategic objectives. Fosters partnerships with key business leaders, stakeholders, and/or customers, identifying opportunities for expanding partnerships and promoting long-term organizational success. Champions transparency and inclusivity by actively seeking, listening to, and incorporating diverse perspectives.

Problem Solving:

– Leads specialized, advanced problem-solving efforts, serving as an escalation point for complex issues. Guides others to leverage innovative data-driven techniques to address ambiguous or novel issues, identify root causes, and drives the implementation of solutions that prevent future issues.

Continuous Learning:

– Leverages deep industry knowledge and expertise to serve as a thought leader within the organization. Contributes to the advancement of the field or industry through thought leadership (e.g., conference presentations, white papers, research contributions). Maintains and evolves expertise in relevant areas by proactively monitoring emerging trends, technologies, and industry standards, ensuring the organization remains current with best practices. Champions continuous learning and knowledge sharing, promoting professional development across teams. Applies new knowledge to drive advancement and mentors others to do the same.

Continuous Improvement:

– Develops innovative solutions and drives the implementation of ideas that increase the efficiency and effectiveness of processes, protocols, and workflows across the organization. Evaluates effectiveness of updated approaches and methods for continued improvement to enhance efficiencies and ensure changes align with organizational goals. Designs and develops metrics to measure success of improvement initiatives.

Performance and Development:

– Serves as a subject matter expert regarding talent needs and organizational talent strategy. Imparts leadership and expert knowledge throughout the talent development pipeline including candidate interviews, candidate assessment, and hiring decisions, ensuring alignment with organizational talent strategy.

Qualifications

new_jobs.title: Technical Program Manager
new_jobs.description:
At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.

We are looking to hire an experienced Senior Technical Program Manager who can be part of a world-class team that builds Snowflake’s product and cloud platform. This role is a unique opportunity to make a significant impact by building a flexible, large scale, high-performance, and resilient platform for Snowlake features and services. Be part of the vision to create the best data cloud platform. Our ‘get it done’ culture allows everyone at Snowflake to have an equal opportunity to innovate on new ideas, create work with a lasting impact, and excel in a culture of collaboration.

AS A SENIOR TECHNICAL PROGRAM MANAGER, YOU WILL:

Be responsible for defining and delivering important programs with broad organizational, business and technical impact.
Provide cross-functional leadership with Engineering and Product Management, and inter/intra team communications to deliver outstanding program outcomes.
Bring strong, data-driven and strategic technical judgment to decisions.
Be hands-on, working closely with Software Engineers and Product Managers to design, build, and deliver the next generation of Snowflake services and apps.
Amplify your impact by educating and mentoring the TPM and Engineering communities on program management best practices.
Identify opportunities to improve execution of the organization as a whole, to increase engineering productivity through tools and light-weight processes. (Snowflake happens to have a nice data platform to use :-)

A SENIOR TECHNICAL PROGRAM MANAGER AT SNOWFLAKE IS EXPECTED TO HAVE:

5+ years of demonstrated industry experience and expertise leading medium to large complex engineering projects in current cloud technologies
Ability to thrive and succeed in a dynamic environment not slowed down by ambiguity or competing priorities
Experience working cross functionally with engineering, product management, and other functions involved in the product life cycle
Strong program management skills with technical and business acumen
Effective verbal and written communication and presentation skills, with the ability to interact with technical and non-technical groups
Excellent analytical, problem-solving, consultation and organizational skills
BS/MS/PhD degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related fields or equivalent practical experience (e.g. familiarity with SQL, Python, Data)

Snowflake is growing fast, and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Snowflake.

How do you want to make your impact?

The estimated base salary range for this role is $221,000 - $317,400.
Additionally, this role is eligible to participate in Snowflake’s bonus and equity plan.

This role is also eligible for a competitive benefits package that includes: medical, dental, vision, life, and disability insurance; 401(k) retirement plan; flexible spending & health savings account; at least 12 paid holidays; paid time off; parental leave; employee assistance program; and other company benefits.

Position Overview

JOB DESCRIPTION

Oracle Government Defense & Intelligence is seeking a Senior Technical Program Manager to manage technical programs and moderately complex, cross-organizational initiatives supporting sovereign and government cloud capabilities. This role will collaborate with engineering, operations, product, security, compliance, and stakeholder teams to align priorities, establish scope and milestones, manage dependencies and risks, and drive execution against measurable program outcomes. The ideal candidate brings technical fluency, strong program discipline, business acumen, and the ability to translate ambiguous requirements into clear plans, communications, and delivery mechanisms.

Who We Are

Oracle Sovereign Cloud builds and operates secure cloud capabilities for mission-critical government workloads. Our programs require disciplined execution across engineering, operations, compliance, security, and customer-facing teams to deliver reliable, secure, and operationally ready cloud services.

Responsibilities

Key Responsibilities

Collaborate with management, engineering, and stakeholders to align priorities, goals, scope, milestones, and execution plans for technical programs.
Manage technical programs and moderately complex, cross-organizational initiatives impacting products, services, operations, or business outcomes.
Identify, track, and manage program dependencies, risks, bottlenecks, scope, timelines, feasibility, testing needs, resourcing, and mitigation plans.
Drive program execution across development, release management, operations, security, compliance, customer success, and stakeholder teams.
Support product or service delivery and help ensure applicable third-party, security, export, and accessibility compliance requirements are addressed.
Coordinate rapid response to escalations, security issues, incidents, and operational risks; communicate status and recommended paths to senior team members when needed.
Maintain program documentation, status reports, dashboards, forecasts, decision records, action registers, and program tracking mechanisms.
Monitor KPIs and program performance against goals, including scope, timelines, deliverable quality, SLA adherence, productivity targets, and customer satisfaction risks.
Contribute to process improvements, automation opportunities, delivery standards, SOP updates, operational efficiencies, and continuous improvement practices.
Facilitate collaboration with and between stakeholder teams, ensuring smooth communication, clear ownership, and follow-through on program goals.

Minimum Qualifications

U.S. Citizenship
8 years of experience as a Program Manager leading large technical programs or projects, development or implementation projects, or complex cross-functional programs from conception to delivery; or bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Business Administration, Software Development, Electrical/Hardware Engineering, or related field and 4 years of such experience; or master's degree in one of those fields and 2 years of such experience; or doctorate in one of those fields.
Demonstrated ability to manage program scope, milestones, dependencies, risks, resourcing, status reporting, documentation, and stakeholder communications.
Experience working across engineering, operations, product, security, compliance, customer, or business teams to deliver technical outcomes.
Demonstrated ability to translate ambiguous requirements into executable plans, independently monitor timelines and deliverables, prioritize work, and adapt to resource or timeline shifts.
Demonstrated ability or knowledge in business acumen, including applying business principles and industry trends to inform decision-making.
Demonstrated ability to use agile methodologies to drive continuous improvement and product delivery.
Demonstrated ability to identify, address, and resolve conflicts to maintain positive team dynamics.
Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to produce clear program updates, decision records, and leadership-ready summaries.

Preferred Qualifications

U.S. Citizenship with active US Government security clearance, TS/SCI with Poly, at hire.
9 years of experience as a Program Manager leading large technical programs or projects, development or implementation projects, or complex cross-functional programs from conception to delivery; or bachelor's degree in a relevant field and 5 years of such experience; or master's degree and 3 years of such experience; or doctorate and 1 year of such experience.
1 year of experience working with operating budgets and/or project financials.
6 years of experience in enterprise cloud services or experience working directly with large enterprise customers, including Oracle Cloud Infrastructure, cloud services, networking, SaaS products, scalable distributed backend services, cloud native design, or systems development lifecycles.
3 years of experience using software development lifecycle methodologies, practices, and associated tooling, including Agile or Scaled Agile Framework (SAFe).
3 years of experience leading cross-functional and cross-level matrixed teams to achieve project goals.
1 year of experience facilitating large meetings and driving consensus among diverse stakeholders.
2 years of experience communicating program status, end-to-end delivery, and results to leadership.
3 years of experience in data analysis and reporting.
2 years of experience in software development, software development management, or software implementation consulting projects.
Project management and delivery certifications such as Certified Scrum Master (CSM), Project Management Professional (PMP), Lean Six Sigma Black Belt, or ITIL.
Experience supporting regulated, classified, sovereign, government, or air-gapped cloud environments.

About The Company

Valon is the leading AI platform for mortgage servicing, building the AI-native operating system for regulated finance.

Before providing the system of record that powers the entire industry, we built and ran our own mortgage servicer on it. That gave us a real regulated environment to prove our technology could replace the mainframe systems servicers have used for decades. Carrington acquired that servicer and adopted ValonOS as its core platform, allowing us to focus entirely on scaling our SaaS platform.

ValonOS is now on track to power 1 in 6 U.S. mortgages across major mortgage servicers like Newrez, Carrington, and ServiceMac. Every process on the platform is structured and programmable, enabling our AI agents to perform core servicing work, like handling payments, escrow, and homeowner questions, directly within the system's controls.

We recently raised a $150 million Series D at a $2.3 billion valuation by new investor Ribbit Capital, with continued support from existing backer a16z, amongst others.

Valon is rebuilding the mortgage servicing industry from the ground up . We're looking for a Technical Program Manager (TPM)
to join our team and help us launch complex products that will revolutionize how mortgage servicers operate. This is an exciting opportunity to shape the future of our TPM function and make a significant impact on our product development process.

In this role, you'll be instrumental in coordinating efforts across multiple engineering teams, ensuring seamless communication, and driving the successful delivery of our most critical initiatives. If you're a seasoned TPM with a passion for tackling challenging problems and a desire to build a function from the ground up, we encourage you to apply.

Manage Stakeholder Expectations: Proactively communicate program status, risks, and dependencies to all relevant stakeholders, ensuring transparency and alignment.

Define and Track Metrics: Establish clear success metrics for programs and regularly track progress, providing data-driven insights to inform decision-making.
Contribute to Team Growth: As our second TPM, you'll have a unique opportunity to help define the vision, strategy, and best practices for the TPM function at Valon.

What You'll Bring

5+ years of experience as a Technical Program Manager in a fast-paced, complex software development environment.
Proven track record of successfully delivering large-scale, cross-functional technical programs.
Strong understanding of the software development lifecycle (SDLC) and various agile methodologies.
Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to influence and align diverse stakeholders.

new_jobs.description:
About Us

National Grid is hiring a Senior Project Manager for our Capital Project Delivery department in Syracuse NY or Northboro MA.

Every day we deliver safe and secure energy to homes, communities, and businesses. We are there when people need us the most. We connect people to the energy they need for the lives they live.

The pace of change in society and our industry is accelerating and our expertise and track record puts us in an unparalleled position to shape the sustainable future of our industry. To be successful we must anticipate the needs of our customers, reducing the cost of energy delivery today and pioneering the flexible energy systems of tomorrow. This requires us to deliver on our promises and always look for new opportunities to grow, both ourselves and our business

Job Purpose

The Reliability Compliance & Policy (RC&P) team helps protect the integrity of National Grid’s operations by providing leadership, governance, and oversight of the company’s NERC compliance framework. RC&P connects regulatory policy, standards development, compliance readiness, ongoing compliance, risk management, and regulatory assurance to help the business anticipate change, manage compliance risk, and maintain a strong and sustainable compliance posture.

The Senior Program Manager, NERC Standards Development & Compliance Readiness
owns the bridge between development of a reliability requirement and National Grid's ability to sustainably comply with that requirement. The value of the position is to influence the requirement early, understand its business impact, prepare the organization for it, and ensure a controlled transition into ongoing compliance.

The role is responsible for leading National Grid's engagement in the development, evaluation, interpretation, and implementation of new and revised North American Electric Reliability Corporation (NERC) Reliability Standards and applicable Northeast Power Coordinating Council (NPCC) requirements.

The role provides end-to-end leadership across the standards lifecycle, from emerging reliability and security issues and early standards development through formal commenting and balloting, applicability and gap assessment, compliance readiness, implementation, and transition to ongoing compliance.

Working with the affected functions across the organization, the Senior Program Manager translates evolving regulatory requirements into clear business impacts, coordinates subject matter expert engagement, identifies implementation risks, and drives the actions necessary to achieve timely and sustainable compliance.

The position also represents National Grid in industry forums and coordinates company positions on proposed standards, helping ensure National Grid has an effective voice in the development of reliability standards and requirements affecting the Bulk Electric System.

Key Accountabilities

Standards Development: Monitor and assess new and revised NERC Reliability Standards, NPCC requirements, reliability guidelines, and related initiatives. Coordinate National Grid SME review, comments, positions, and voting recommendations to help shape requirements before they are finalized.
Compliance Readiness & Implementation: Lead end-to-end readiness for new and revised Reliability Standards, including applicability and gap assessments, requirement interpretation, implementation planning, action tracking, development of procedures and controls, readiness sign-off, and transition to ongoing compliance.
Regulatory Interpretation & Risk: Evaluate requirements for applicability, implementation impacts, compliance risks, and potential business implications, documenting conclusions and escalating significant issues to appropriate stakeholders and leadership.
Stakeholder & SME Leadership: Lead cross-functional engagement with technical SMEs, compliance teams, and business leaders to ensure requirements are understood, responsibilities are clear, implementation challenges are resolved, and the organization is prepared to achieve sustainable compliance.
Industry Engagement: Represent and coordinate National Grid participation in NERC, NPCC, EEI, NATF, and other relevant industry forums to remain informed of emerging reliability issues, influence standards development, and bring industry perspectives and leading practices back to National Grid.
Governance & Program Management: Maintain oversight of the standards-development and compliance-readiness portfolio, including regulatory milestones, effective dates, implementation activities, risks, dependencies, and leadership reporting, while continually improving the governance framework, processes, tools, and controls supporting the program.
Compliance Assurance & Audit Support: Provide subject matter expertise for regulatory audits and reviews involving newly implemented standards, support regulatory inquiries and Requests for Information, and incorporate lessons learned from implementations and audits into future standards and readiness activities.

Qualifications

Required

Bachelor's degree in engineering, business, risk management, cybersecurity, legal, or a related discipline, or equivalent relevant experience.
Experience in the electric utility industry, regulatory compliance, reliability, risk management, operations, engineering, cybersecurity, or a related field.
Demonstrated ability to manage complex, cross-functional programs involving multiple organizations and competing priorities.
Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret complex technical and regulatory requirements and translate them into practical business actions.
Demonstrated experience facilitating discussions with technical SMEs and senior stakeholders.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to communicate complex regulatory issues to technical and executive audiences.
Strong organizational, project-management, facilitation, and stakeholder-management skills.
Occasional travel across the US and Canada is required (<5%); a US Passport is required.

Preferred

Experience with NERC Reliability Standards and Rules of Procedure, NPCC requirements, and/or the NERC Compliance Monitoring and Enforcement Program.
Experience with both Operations & Planning (O&P) and Critical Infrastructure Protection (CIP) Reliability Standards.
Experience with NERC or Regional Entity standards development, commenting, balloting, or industry committee processes.
Experience conducting compliance readiness, gap assessments, applicability evaluations, internal control assessments, or regulatory implementation programs.
Experience developing or reviewing RSAWs, compliance evidence, procedures, controls, or audit documentation.
Familiarity with Governance, Risk & Compliance platforms such as Archer.

More Information

Salary

Northboro, MA: $123,000 - $144,000 a year

Syracuse, NY: $109,000 - $128,000 a year

Salary is commensurate with experience and location.

Experience with facility construction or infrastructure delivery supporting manufacturing, test, or launch operations environments, including specialized infrastructure such as launch pads, test stands, or similar

Demonstrated success working with general contractors, subcontractors, and field construction leadership to ensure on-time, on-budget delivery of high-quality construction

Program Management Professional (PMP) certification and Earned Value Management System (EVMS) experience; experience with critical path scheduling, risk management, and cost account management such as EVM

Riverside Research is seeking an Information System Security Manager to administer several classified programs, to include Assessment & Authorization (A&A) requirements. This position functions as an ISSM, responsible for the development and oversight of a comprehensive information security program as identified in applicable customer requirements to include NISPOM, ICD 503/CNSSI 1253, DFARS, NIST 800-53, NIST 800-171, JSIG, etc.

Create and maintain A&A packages, System Security Plans (SSPs), Risk Assessment Reports (RARs), Security Controls Traceability Matrices (SCTMs) and Plans of Action & Milestones (POA&Ms) for assigned classified systems
Establish and administer appropriate security systems, policies, standards, and procedures in compliance with applicable government and corporate directives, guidelines, and contractual obligations
Conduct analysis and assessment of the security control assessment guidance, procedures, and templates, ensuring correct and uniform implementation of the new RMF based assessment processes
Configure and validate information system compliance using DISA STIGs, SCAP Compliance Checker (SCC) and STIG Viewer
Conduct regular audits/CM in accordance with government customer requirements
Provide technical and professional leadership to support personnel, provide oversight for assigned classified system compliance and conduct self-assessments at multiple Riverside Research offices
Provide CM for security-relevant information system software, hardware and firmware
Investigate information system security violations and prepare reports with corrective actions and preventative measures.
Make recommendations regarding tools, trend analysis and applicable network countermeasures
Interfaces directly with DCSA or other DoD entities to conduct Information System security inspections, tests, and reviews
Guarantee system security requirements are addressed during all phases of system life cycle
Ensures system security assessments and audits are completed and documented
Certify that all Information System authorization documentation is current and accessible to authorized individuals
Supervisor assigned ISSO's
